job.title: Fan Support Coordinator - Assessment Centre
job.html_description:
Join Manchester City in a Manchester-based Fan Support Coordinator opportunity and help create a welcoming, reliable experience for supporters across matchdays and non-matchday events. Full-time, part-time and casual roles are available. All opportunities include matchday work, so regular evening and weekend availability is essential.

 

We will be hosting a Fan Support Coordinator Assessment Centre at the Etihad Stadium on Monday 30th November 2026, this event is an opportunity to demonstrate your customer service approach and be considered for the role, or roles, that best match your experience and plans.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Fan Support team helps supporters access the sales and services they need across every available contact channel, at our stadia and for non-matchday events. The team combines helpful service, accurate fulfilment and practical problem-solving to make each interaction clear, consistent and positive.

 

The Role

 

As a Fan Support Coordinator, you will be part of the day-to-day operation that supports Manchester City’s Fans. You will provide friendly, courteous service, respond to enquiries and help supporters complete purchases and access the right information across our available sales and service channels.

 

You will sell and fulfil sales and service products, resolve queries and manage issues through to an appropriate outcome. Accuracy matters: you will follow ticket quality and validity procedures, complete relevant checks and reconcile fulfilment activity so that supporters receive a dependable service.

 

Working independently and as part of a collaborative team, you will organise a varied workload, build positive relationships with supporter groups and contribute to service targets. You will also share practical ideas that can improve our processes and the experience we provide.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in a customer sales and service environment, with a focus on helpful and accurate support.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to engage respectfully with people at all levels.

⚽ Ability to organise tasks, manage changing priorities and deliver accurately to agreed deadlines.

⚽ Comfortable following operational procedures, quality checks and reconciliation processes.

⚽ Ability to resolve customer queries thoughtfully and recognise when an issue needs additional support.

⚽ Availability to work matchdays, including evenings and weekends, in Manchester.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 22 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Community Coach - Employability
job.html_description:
Community Coach – Employability (Part Time)

This Community Coach – Employability role is an opportunity to help young people across Greater Manchester build confidence, develop essential skills and take positive steps towards their future. Working closely with participants, colleagues and community partners, you will deliver engaging employability programmes that support young people into education, employment and training.

 

Who We Are

Established in 1986, City in the Community is Manchester City’s official charity. We support people across Manchester by empowering healthier lives through football. Our programmes place physical and mental wellbeing at their core, whilst also creating healthy futures and healthy communities.

Within our Education team, we support young people to develop the skills, confidence and experience needed to progress into positive futures. Through our Youth Hub, City Careers and volunteering programmes, we work alongside employers, education providers and community partners to help young people overcome barriers and access meaningful opportunities in education, employment and training.

 

The Role

This is a part time role working 22.5 hours across three days per week. You will support the planning and delivery of City in the Community's employability programmes for young people aged 16–25, including the Youth Hub, City Careers and volunteering, helping participants build confidence, resilience and essential skills for their future.

Day to day, you will deliver engaging employability, football and sport sessions, mentor participants and support their progression into education, employment or training. You will also work closely with employers, the DWP, referral agencies and community partners to support participant recruitment, work experience opportunities and positive outcomes.

Alongside programme delivery, you will monitor participant progress, maintain accurate records and contribute to programme reporting against agreed KPIs. You will also support wider CITC 16+ programmes where required, while ensuring safeguarding and organisational policies are embedded across all activities.

 

What You'll Bring

⚽ Experience planning and delivering employability or life skills programmes for young people aged 16–25.

⚽ A minimum Level 2 Coaching Certificate in any sport or relevant activity.

⚽ Strong knowledge of the local employability landscape, including barriers faced by young people not in education, employment or training (NEET).

⚽ Experience supporting young people facing complex barriers, with an understanding of safeguarding and behaviour management.

⚽ Experience building relationships with employers, schools, colleges and community partners.

⚽ Excellent communication and Microsoft Office skills, with a resilient and adaptable approach. Experience supporting young people with additional needs would be an advantage.

⚽ A full UK driving licence.

 

Why Choose Us

Guided by our values of being caring, inclusive, transformative and youth-led, we are committed to creating an environment where our team feel supported, valued and able to make a meaningful difference through the work they do every day.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 1st December 2026.

 

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We strive to provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodation to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact citcjobs@cityfootball.com.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Matchday Steward (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)


Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for a self-motivated, detail orientated and hardworking cleaner to join our team. You will be responsible for making sure that the site is clean, presentable. This can entail dusting, polishing, mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, and cleaning smudges off windows and doors.


Responsibilities:

  • Being responsible for all basic cleaning in and around the building.

  • Cleaning floors and rooms - including dust mopping, damp mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, picking up objects off the floor, and spot cleaning glass and windows.

  • Cleaning restrooms, including restocking dispensers, emptying trash, cleaning and sanitizing fixtures, cleaning mirrors, spot cleaning partition doors and walls, sweeping and mopping tile floors, and cleaning toilets and urinals.

  • Emptying trash, cleaning vacuums and replacing liners

  • Setting up, stocks, and maintains cleaning equipment and supplies.

  • Monitoring and maintaining sanitation and organization of assigned areas.

  • Assisting other departments when needed to ensure optimum service to guests.

  • Liaising with the line manager to ensure that you have sufficient cleaning products at all times.

  • Reporting any breakages that occur during the cleaning process.

  • Informing the line manager of repairs that need to be done.

  • Reporting any large objects obstructing fire exit.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in professional cleaning with exceptionally high standards

  • Attention to detail

  • High standard of discretion and confidentiality

  • Have a strong work ethic, be loyal, passionate, and friendly.

  • Team player – expected to work well and communicate effectively with the team

  • Checkable reference

  • Ability to work with high profile professionals

  • Understanding that our commercial premises may contain confidential paperwork etc

  • Ensuring compliance to sanitation, hygiene, health and safety legislation and organisational and quality requirements and working policies and procedures.

  • Flexible and adaptable at all times

Responsibilities:

  • Understanding all menus, product offerings, packaging and pricing

  • Responsible for preparing and cooking all the hot food such as burgers, pies, hot dogs nachos and specialty items for a unit on match day and meeting peak periods with appropriate food levels

  • Maintain high standards of food presentation and quality with regular controls

  • Ensure all products are accounted for, prepared and distributed according to cook-off numbers and instructions from your manager

  • Restock and ensure the food prep area is clean at the end of your shift

  • Ensure all kitchen unit equipment (electrical or otherwise) is cleaned down and properly maintained at the end of every shift

  • Adhere and keep up to date records for food and health and safety standards such as food temperature control levels and following the club’s Food Safety Management System

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies and Security policies

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Food Safety Level 2 certificate and strong knowledge of proper food handling procedures

  • Experience grilling or cooking food in mass quantities, particularly in a busy or similar environment

  • A can-do attitude and be prepared to help the rest of the team out with a positive attitude

  • Immaculate grooming standards and overall appearance

job.title: Maintenance Operative
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:     Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for an experienced and skilled Maintenance operative to perform and upkeep tasks such as repairs, inspections, plumbing, carpentry, painting, decorating, general maintenance and planned improvement services to our facilitates. The individual will be responsible for assisting other trades when required to ensure the highest level of service across our sites.


Responsibilities:

  • Undertake the day-to-day general maintenance repairs in-house for all our facilities but mainly at our Academy Training Ground.

  • Undertake painting work, such as preparing painting surfaces, removing old paint, mixing and matching paints, and to use correct utilities to prepare the surrounding areas in order to prevent messes.

  • Undertake plumbing work, such as fixing leaks, unblocking drains and gutters, shower fitting, and more.

  • Undertake tiling and decorating work, such as, preparing surfaces by levelling off with the correct material, measuring and applying tiles, repairing/removing old surfaces, add more.

  • Undertake carpentry work, such as taking measurements and installing shelves, cabinets, handles, locks and more.

  • Preparation of the facilities for home matches

  • Regular checks and repairs on lights, toilets, and seats.

  • Completing work in accordance with the Crystal Palace specifications and in compliance with the relevant Legislation and industry best practices

  • Working to operational procedures, safe working practices and Health and Safety procedures as required.

  • Providing general support and assistance to the Maintenance Manager

  • Inspecting the Training ground and Academy and it’s adjoining structures on a daily and weekly basis to ensure they are all well-kept and in order.

  • Completing works at other Crystal Palace Football Club grounds and facilities including the Academy Training Ground.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a maintenance environment.

  • Experience in plumbing, painting, decorating, carpentry, and general maintenance.

  • Basic knowledge of maintenance systems such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical etc.

  • Ability to read manuals and drawings.

  • Experience using hand and electrical tools.

  • Experience working in large scale stadiums/ buildings.


Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

job.title: Matchday SIA Steward
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £14.75 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • You must be over 18 (Essential).

  • SIA Door Supervisor Badge (Essential).

  • NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (Desirable).

  • Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners.

  • Mature and able to handle situations calmly.

  • Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous.

  • A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect.

  • Good communication skills.

  • An understanding of body search regulations and processes.

  • Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable).

job.title: Logistics & Fulfilment Operative (Casual Contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees.

About this role:

The Logistics Operative plays a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of matchdays and events across Selhurst Park. Responsible for the movement, storage and organisation of food, beverages, equipment and disposables, the role ensures kiosks, bars and hospitality areas are fully stocked, organised and operational.

Working as part of the Public Catering team, the Logistics Operative helps maintain high standards of cleanliness, food safety and operational efficiency, ensuring an exceptional experience for supporters, guests and clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Receive, check and store food, beverage and equipment deliveries.

  • Ensure stock is rotated and stored in accordance with company procedures.

  • Support stock counts and stock reconciliation activities.

  • Report shortages, damages and discrepancies to management.

  • Maintain accurate stock records where required.

  • Prepare kiosks, bars and catering areas for operation.

  • Distribute food, beverage, equipment and disposable stock throughout the stadium.

  • Support premium areas and event spaces with operational requirements.

  • Ensure units are replenished efficiently throughout service.

  • Respond quickly and effectively to operational requests during matchdays and events.

  • Maintain cellar areas to a high operational standard.

  • Support beer line cleaning procedures where required.

  • Ensure food stores, disposable stock rooms and chemical storage areas are clean, organised and compliant.

  • Assist with the movement and handling of kegs and heavy stock items using safe working practices.

  • Complete HACCP, delivery, temperature and cleaning records accurately.

  • Follow all Health & Safety, Food Safety, COSHH and manual handling procedures.

  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness throughout operational areas.

  • Report maintenance issues, hazards and incidents promptly.

  • Work closely with the Stock Controller, Hub Leaders and management team to ensure operational requirements are met.

  • Support colleagues across the department where required.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and operational issues promptly.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience working within hospitality, catering, logistics, warehouse or customer-facing environments.

  • Flexible approach to working hours, including evenings, weekends and matchdays.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently and use initiative.

  • Previous experience within logistics, cellar operations or stock control. (Desirable)

  • Experience working in a stadium, arena or large-scale event environment. (Desirable)

  • Experience handling food and beverage stock. (Desirable)

  • Level 2 Food Safety Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Manual Handling Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Counterbalance Forklift Licence. (Desirable)

  • Personal Licence Holder. (Desirable)

  • First Aid qualification. (Desirable)

About this role:
The Logistics Operative plays a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of matchdays and events across Selhurst Park. Responsible for the movement, storage and organisation of food, beverages, equipment and disposables, the role ensures kiosks, bars and hospitality areas are fully stocked, organised and operational.
Working as part of the Public Catering team, the Logistics Operative helps maintain high standards of cleanliness, food safety and operational efficiency, ensuring an exceptional experience for supporters, guests and clients.
Responsibilities:
- Receive, check and store food, beverage and equipment deliveries. - Ensure stock is rotated and stored in accordance with company procedures. - Support stock counts and stock reconciliation activities. - Report shortages, damages and discrepancies to management. - Maintain accurate stock records where required. - Prepare kiosks, bars and catering areas for operation. - Distribute food, beverage, equipment and disposable stock throughout the stadium. - Support premium areas and event spaces with operational requirements. - Ensure units are replenished efficiently throughout service. - Respond quickly and effectively to operational requests during matchdays and events. - Maintain cellar areas to a high operational standard. - Support beer line cleaning procedures where required. - Ensure food stores, disposable stock rooms and chemical storage areas are clean, organised and compliant. - Assist with the movement and handling of kegs and heavy stock items using safe working practices. - Complete HACCP, delivery, temperature and cleaning records accurately. - Follow all Health & Safety, Food Safety, COSHH and manual handling procedures. - Maintain high standards of cleanliness throughout operational areas. - Report maintenance issues, hazards and incidents promptly. - Work closely with the Stock Controller, Hub Leaders and management team to ensure operational requirements are met. - Support colleagues across the department where required. - Communicate shortages, equipment failures and operational issues promptly. - Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager. - Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.
Experience, Skills and Qualifications:
- Experience working within hospitality, catering, logistics, warehouse or customer-facing environments. - Flexible approach to working hours, including evenings, weekends and matchdays. - Strong communication and teamwork skills. - Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. - Ability to work independently and use initiative. - Previous experience within logistics, cellar operations or stock control. (Desirable) - Experience working in a stadium, arena or large-scale event environment. (Desirable) - Experience handling food and beverage stock. (Desirable) - Level 2 Food Safety Certificate. (Desirable) - Manual Handling Certificate. (Desirable) - Counterbalance Forklift Licence. (Desirable) - Personal Licence Holder. (Desirable) - First Aid qualification. (Desirable)

job.title: Matchday Hub Leader (Casual)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £16.67 p/h

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Hub Leader is a senior front-line catering team member responsible for the safe and efficient operation of a designated concession or bar unit on matchdays and events. Acting as the main point of contact within their area, the Hub Leader is responsible for ensuring excellent guest service, accurate stock control and that all team members operate in accordance with Club standards and legal requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the full operation of a designated concession or bar unit from set-up to close-down.

  • Attend pre-match/pre-event briefings and prepare the unit for service.

  • Complete close-down duties and support final counts and cleaning.

  • Liaise with the Concessions Supervisor and management team to ensure the smooth operation of the area.

  • Deliver exceptional service to supporters and guests, including dealing with customer complaints and resolving issues in a professional manner.

  • Promote product knowledge and upselling opportunities.

  • Ensure accurate counting and control of food, beverages and disposables.

  • Ensure stock is handled securely and replenished accurately throughout service.

  • Monitor stock usage during the event and communicate shortages proactively.

  • Record wastage, transfers and returns in accordance with training.

  • Maintain regular communication with the Concessions Supervisor and management team.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and maintenance issues promptly.

  • Escalate concerns proactively to minimise disruption to service.

  • Lead by example while supporting, motivating, and developing team members.

  • Ensure key information is effectively communicated to team members.

  • Ensure food safety, hygiene and operational standards are maintained at all times.

  • Ensure all required documentation is completed accurately and on time.

  • Ensure licensing regulations are followed, with particular attention to Challenge 25 and protecting children from harm.

  • Monitor the correct use of PPE, handwashing and food handling procedures.

  • Ensure products are served to agreed specifications and brand standards.

  • Support stock accuracy and waste reduction initiatives.

  • Complete all paperwork accurately and within required timescales.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in hospitality, retail, catering, or other fast-paced customer-facing environments.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and customer service skills.

  • Ability to work independently, use initiative, and remain calm under pressure.

  • Previous team leader or supervisory experience.

  • Experience with EPOS systems, cash handling, and stock control.

  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays

  • Personal Licence Holder (desirable)

  • Reliable, responsible, and professional, consistently leading by example.

  • Positive and supportive, with the ability to motivate others and remain calm under pressure.

job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            22nd November 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

To lead and manage the catering team at our Stadium Selhurst Park. The Head Chef will maintain the highest standards of food quality, safety and hygiene, oversee and direct all food preparation processes, and create a positive kitchen environment that others enjoy being part of.

Responsibilities:

  • Following the guidance of the Head of Culinary and have input in new ways of presentation or dishes

  • Working quickly and accurately during busy periods, such as weekends and evenings

  • Overall responsibility for the daily operations in all kitchens across premium areas on matchdays and non-matchday events

  • Be hands on in the kitchen where needed

  • Ensure all chefs inhouse, casual and agency are following instructions and maintaining standards

  • Expectation to work all home matchdays where possible

  • Verifying all food products are properly dated and organised for quality assurance. Including distributing foods from central main kitchen to satellite kitchens and checked ready for matchday service

  • Providing guidance to junior kitchen staff members, including, but not limited, to line cooking, food preparation, and dish plating

  • Participate fully in the delivery of the department’s budgets and targets including labour set by Head of Culinary

  • Ensuring food safety best practices and makes sure that all kitchen staff members do the same

  • Completing all relevant food hygiene, HACCP and delivery documentation

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • A catering and hospitality qualification

  • Food Hygiene Certificate Level 3(This can also be provided)

  • Experience working as a Head Chef in a busy, fast paced environment

  • Experience within an organisation where large numbers for catering are required including various food services

  • A self-starter and able to take the initiative to complete tasks

  • Able to cope under pressure in a calm and efficient manner to set and meet deadlines

  • Willing to work flexible hours as regular weekend, bank holiday and evening work is required

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days

If you have experience as a kitchen porter working in a busy kitchen environment, we have a role for you. Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for a Kitchen Porter to ensure the kitchen is clean, tidy, safe and hygienic at all times and to assist kitchen and hospitality staff to ensure that service runs smoothly.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring basic cleaning jobs are carried out as quickly as possible including: food preparation areas, equipment, crockery, cutlery, pots and pans

  • bins checked and cleaned structure of the kitchen (walls/skirting/doors)large equipment including rationale oven/brat pan/ blast chiller/ walk in fridge/ walk in freezer

  • Keeping control and maintain organization in food store room(s), chemical storage cupboard and disposable stores

  • Controlling the chemical’s storage cupboard and disposable store

  • Receiving, checking and organizing goods and deliveries

  • Completing all relevant HACCP, food hygiene, delivery, temperature and cleaning logs as legally required and ensuring it is signed off by a chef in charge daily

  • Adhere to all aspects of Fire, Health & Safety, Food Hygiene, Licencing law, Challenge 21, Trading Standards, COSHH and other policies

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

job.title: U21 Physiotherapist
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            19th November 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

  • To deliver outstanding physiotherapy services to Crystal Palace FC U21 players, aiming to optimise performance, reduce injury risk and minimise recovery time from injury.

  • Responsible for leading on all aspects of U21 players’ medical and physiotherapy requirements, including rehabilitation of U21 players in collaboration with the medical and performance support teams.

  • To adopt a player-centred, interdisciplinary approach to player care.

  • To inspire player development and performance through individualised care, positive connection and the highest professional standards.

  • To drive the highest medical and performance standards in Academy football, by participating in periodic structured review and refinement of processes.

Responsibilities:

Leadership and Communication

  • To communicate effectively with the U21 interdisciplinary team to ensure the highest quality care of U21 players - especially with respect to managing injury risk, performance preparedness, rehabilitation and holistic player needs.

  • Co-ordinating the daily and long-term schedules for injured players.

  • To develop strong working relationships with 1st team and U18 staff to ensure effective transition of players between age-groups.

Clinical

  • Providing an excellent standard of assessment, treatment and rehabilitation to all players.

  • To lead on musculoskeletal screening for U21 players, and, in collaboration with the wider interdisciplinary team, to develop individualised plans aimed at reducing injury risk and optimising readiness to perform.

  • To provide medical cover for every U21 fixture (including away travel).

  • Accompanying players to medical appointments as required.

Administration

  • Ensuring all players’ medical files are up to date in accordance with professional body standards, stored securely with relevant medical information, and shared to appropriate stakeholders.

  • To contribute positively to the Crystal Palace Football Club Medical and Performance Operations Manual.

  • To carry out departmental administration tasks as required (including FA Whereabouts information).

  • To ensure physiotherapy equipment and supplies are maintained, stored and replenished to a high standard.

  • To produce daily and weekly rehabilitation plans for sports science and medicine staff.

  • To produce weekly injury reports and to collate data for the CPFC Academy availability audit.

  • To participate and contribute to the CPFC Academy Continuing Professional Development programme.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Chartered Physiotherapist with HCPC and CSP registration.

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience working in professional football – including experience working in a Category One Academy.

  • Postgraduate qualifications in Sports Medicine / Strength & Conditioning / Sport Science (MSc/PhD) – or working towards.

  • Up to date ATMMIF qualification

  • Significant experience of using clinical, gym-based and pitch-based objective measures to inform clinical decision making in rehabilitation.

  • Evidence of completion of the FA Safeguarding Children course.

  • Knowledgeable of current sports injury research

  • Knowledgeable in the assessment, treatment and diagnosis of sports injuries

  • Comprehensive knowledge of rehabilitation and injury reduction strategies

  • Caring, positive and enthusiastic nature with players and staff

  • Decisive – able to make decisions based on sound reasoning and communicating them clearly and appropriately with players and staff

  • Soft skills: team player, organised, composed, conscientious

  • Flexible, especially in terms of the hours that will be necessary

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.title: Editorial Content Executive
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB | London, London, W1F 9SJ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Flexible across our Central London office, Selhurst Park, and Training Ground

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            22nd November 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Editorial Content Executive is responsible for producing written content output across the club’s digital estate (cpfc.co.uk and the Official Palace App) and matchday programme.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Editorial Manager and wider marketing and comms department, and will deliver best-in-class storytelling that inspires, informs and connects with our supporters all around the world, while working at pace, and with sensitivity and uncompromising attention to detail.

The successful candidate will be expected to produce a range of written articles for our digital channels as well as oversee and co-ordinate the production of our matchday programmes, commissioning and editing guest/freelance contributions.

The individual will develop effective working relationships across club teams (Men’s, Women’s, Academy teams), while supporting colleagues across the club in the football department, marketing, retail, ticketing, commercial, premium hospitality, and operations with their communication requirements.

Based primarily in our Central London office, but with the flexibility to travel to Selhurst Park and our training facilities in Beckenham as the role demands, the successful candidate will be expected to work during the week, and approximately half of our Men’s first-team domestic matchdays, plus European matchdays (with subsequent lieu days to be agreed with the Editorial Manager).

Application:

When applying, please include a portfolio of up to three written pieces which you feel best showcase your written content production skills.

Responsibilities:


Digital Written Content:

  • Under the direction of the Editorial Manager, produce daily written content and publish across the club’s digital channels in line with club developments, campaigns and matchdays.

  • Produce content covering club announcements.

  • Create matchday content, including pre-match previews, live match feed updates, match reports, post-match reaction and features.

  • Produce transfer announcements.

  • Create short-form and long-form features.

  • Produce marketing collateral.

  • Support retail and commercial promotions.

  • Create supporter-focused communications.

  • Ensure this content reaches appropriate audiences through collaboration with the wider Marcomms department, and/or assisting with scheduling targeted push notifications.

  • Propose and produce engaging, emotive and innovative feature content that celebrates and showcases the important stories on our respective teams, and the wider club.

  • Contribute feature ideas to weekly editorial strategy – and assist with the wider content strategy.

  • In collaboration with the Editorial Manager, work on a bespoke series of feature interviews for the club website/app.

  • Interview key contacts, stakeholders and/or talent to obtain information and/or quotations.

Matchday Programmes:

  • Under the direction of the Editorial Manager, play a key part in the production of content for the Men’s (printed) programme.

  • Oversee issue pagination, including special European issues.

  • Ideate and write original content, ensuring this reflects the club’s identity and appeals to supporters.

  • Sourcing and delivery of the programme feature interview for each issue.

  • Keep across relevant campaigns and initiatives to inform contents (e.g. seasonal Premier League campaigns).

  • Lead on sourcing and editing guest contributions.

  • Interviewing key people to obtain content where appropriate, including high-profile talent for features and columns.

  • Support on the production of Women’s (printed and/or digital) matchday programmes when required.

  • Collaborate with Commercial colleagues to ensure advertisement, sponsorship and matchday mascot obligations are fulfilled across Men’s and Women’s programmes.

  • Co-ordinate production so the programme is completed accurately and on schedule, within print deadlines.

Other

  • Work approximately half of Men’s first-team matchdays (with subsequent time off in lieu to be agreed with the Editorial Manager) – including some travel to away fixtures.

  • Develop and maintain effective working relationships and key contacts across the club, collaborating primarily with colleagues in Production, Social Media, Design, and Marketing, but also in the football department, retail, ticketing, commercial, and Operations, to support their communication requirements. This may include supporting the wider editorial team with digital campaigns and club announcements.

  • Promote and maximise the use of the club’s digital products, ensuring content is published effectively and engages supporters.

  • Assist with the management of the club’s recently relaunched digital app, collaborating with the wider production and social teams on vertical content.

  • Leading on supporter communications – in particular surrounding matchdays and European travel information.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Relevant experience as a journalist (NCTJ qualified), or equivalent experience (a minimum of two years working in professional football or digital media).

  • Strong editorial judgement and an understanding of sensitivities around digital club content including confidentiality.

  • Previous experience using a variety of digital content management systems.

  • The ability to vary copy to fit audiences, platforms and our club’s house style.

  • Confidence in preparing questions and interviewing players, staff and other contributors.

  • Strong time management, organisational and prioritisation skills.

  • An eye for detail with the ability to ensure accuracy, consistency and adherence to the club’s editorial style.

  • The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously as we operate in a fast-moving environment with regular, tight deadlines.

  • Strong footballing knowledge.

  • A working knowledge of content analytics is preferred.

  • Able to work to tight deadlines, at pace and juggling multiple workflows.

  • Proactive and inquisitive – a self-starter with initiative.

  • Flexible to work weekends and occasional out-of-hours work when required.

  • As part of the role, you are required to work on approximately half of our Men’s first-team matchdays (with subsequent time off in lieu to be agreed with the Editorial Manager), including some travel. Additional matchday work, including some evenings, may be required from time to time.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.title: Catering Kitchen Cleaner
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

To support the smooth running of Public Catering operations at Crystal Palace Football Club by maintaining excellent standards of cleanliness, hygiene and organisation across our kitchens, kiosks, concessions and associated facilities. The role focuses on deep cleaning and post-matchday recovery, alongside providing practical support to the wider catering and logistics teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Deep clean catering kitchens, kiosks, concessions and food preparation areas.

  • Clean and sanitise cooking equipment, extraction areas, work surfaces and storage facilities.

  • Complete scheduled cleaning tasks and post-matchday cleaning procedures.

  • Ensure all areas are maintained to the Club's food safety and hygiene standards.

  • Dispose of waste correctly and maintain clean, organised working environments.

  • Follow all food safety, health and safety and COSHH procedures.

  • Use cleaning chemicals and equipment safely and correctly.

  • Work effectively with colleagues and complete assigned tasks to the required standard.

  • Undertake other reasonable duties to support Public Catering operations.

Operational & Logistics Support

  • Assist with the breakdown, cleaning and resetting of catering facilities following matchdays and events.

  • Support the movement, storage and organisation of catering equipment, stock and supplies.

  • Assist the logistics team with deliveries, stock movements and general operational duties when required.

  • Identify and report equipment faults, damage or maintenance requirements.

  • Undertake other reasonable duties to support Public Catering operations.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Reliable, hardworking and positive attitude.

  • Excellent attention to detail and high standards of cleanliness.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Comfortable undertaking physical duties and manual handling.

  • Previous experience in commercial cleaning, catering or hospitality.

  • Knowledge of food hygiene and COSHH procedures.

  • Experience working in commercial kitchens or large venues.

  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and around matchday schedules.

job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

To support the preparation and delivery of food across Crystal Palace Football Club by assisting chefs with the assembly, wrapping and presentation of products whilst maintaining the highest standards of food safety, cleanliness and organisation. The role is responsible for ensuring products are prepared and distributed to specification, supporting efficient service on matchdays and events.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist chefs with food preparation and general kitchen duties.

  • Prepare, cook and assemble food products, including hot dogs, pizzas, pies, burgers and other menu items, in line with Club specifications and portion sizes.

  • Maintain food quality, consistency and presentation standards.

  • Follow stock rotation procedures, complete date checks and accurately record food temperatures, wastage and stock counts.

  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and organisation across food preparation and storage areas. Including, following daily cleaning schedules and end-of-shift procedures.

  • Follow all food safety, hygiene, allergen management and health and safety procedures, ensuring food is prepared, stored and handled safely.

  • Ensure waste is disposed of correctly and report equipment faults, maintenance requirements, incidents or hazards promptly.

  • Comply with relevant legislation, Club policies and operational standards.

  • Assist with the distribution and replenishment of food products across kiosks and designated service points.

  • Work collaboratively with chefs, Hub Leaders and the wider catering team to support the smooth running of operations, particularly during busy periods.

  • Demonstrate flexibility in responding to operational requirements, assist other areas when required and undertake any other reasonable duties within the scope of the role.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

Previous experience within hospitality, catering or food preparation.

Experience working in a kitchen or fast-paced food environment.

Experience working at sporting events or large venues.

Level 2 Food Safety Certificate. (desirable)

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.title: Greenkeeper (m/w/d)
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 900 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für neun Tochterunternehmen.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Rasenteams in der BVB Stadionmanagement GmbH suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Greenkeeper (m/w/d) im Rahmen einer Vollzeitbeschäftigung (42 Std./Woche).

Deine Aufgaben
  • Professionelle Pflege und Unterhaltung der Sportrasenflächen und Grünanlagen, z. B. Mähen, Düngen, Bewässern, Nachsäen, Vertikutieren, Aerifizieren, Besanden etc.
  • Beseitigung von Unkräutern, Laub, Grün- und Grasschnitt, Unrat, Abfällen usw.
  • Bedienung und Führung von Arbeitsmaschinen und -geräten sowie deren Pflege und Instandhaltung
  • Vorbereitung und Pflege der Spielfelder und Nebenflächen für den Trainings- und Spielbetrieb im SIGNAL IDUNA PARK und am Trainingsgelände Brackel
  • Auf- und Abbau sowie Kontrolle von baulichen und technischen Anlagen, z. B. Tore, Ballfangnetze, Eckfahnen etc.
  • Spielfeldbetreuung an Heimspieltagen der Profi- und Nachwuchsmannschaften
Dein Profil
  • Abgeschlossene handwerkliche Ausbildung, idealerweise im Garten- bzw. Landschaftsbau oder einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Rasenpflege
  • Handwerkliches Geschick sowie ein gutes Gespür für die Maschinenführung
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und proaktive Arbeitsweise
  • Spaß an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
  • Hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft und Flexibilität sowie Bereitschaft zu Arbeitszeiten an Spieltagen, Wochenenden und am Abend
  • Führerschein Klasse B, Klasse BE wünschenswert
Das erwartet Dich
  • Ein Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert
  • Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Persönliches Mitarbeiter-Ticket für unsere Heimspiele
  • Individuelle Maßnahmen zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio sowie Unterstützung für einen gesunden Arbeitsalltag
  • Weitere Mehrwerte, wie z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Dienstrad-Leasing, Team-Events, Mitarbeiter-Bistro, Altersvorsorge etc.
Jetzt bewerben

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen. Bitte bewirb Dich online über den "Jetzt-bewerben Button".

job.title: Ordner (m/w/d) im BVB Ordnungsdienst
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 900 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für neun Tochterunternehmen.

Zur Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen Veranstaltungsverlaufes betreibt der BVB seit mehr als 30 Jahren einen vereinseigenen Ordnungsdienst für die Heimspiele im SIGNAL IDUNA PARK.

Für die aktuelle Saison suchen wir Verstärkung für unseren vereinseigenen Ordnungsdienst im Rahmen einer Nebentätigkeit.

Deine Aufgaben
  • Ticket- und Personenkontrollen
  • Freihalten von Rettungswegen
  • Platzanweisung
  • Spielfeldabsicherung
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Stadionordnung
Dein Profil
  • Mindestens 18 Jahre alt
  • Eintragsfreies Führungszeugnis
  • Zuverlässigkeit, Freundlichkeit, Teamfähigkeit
  • Körperliche Belastbarkeit und souveränen Umgang mit Stresssituationen
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse
  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit am Abend, an Wochenenden sowie an Feiertagen
Das erwartet Dich
  • Eine Ausbildung gem. DFB-Richtlinien im Bereich QuaSOD (Qualifizierung Sicherheits- und Ordnungsdienste)
  • Arbeiten in einem hoch emotionalen und spannenden Umfeld
  • Einen Platz in einer dynamischen Mannschaft
  • Eine faire Vergütung
  • Einsätze bei den Heimspielen der Profimannschaft, der U23, den BVB-Frauen und bei Sonderveranstaltungen
Jetzt bewerben

job.title: Aushilfe BVB FanWelt
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 900 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für neun Tochterunternehmen.

Die BVB Merchandising GmbH ist ein 100%iges Tochterunternehmen der an der Börse notierten Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA und betreibt die Geschäftsmodelle Ein- und Verkauf sowie Lizenzierung von mit dem Markenzeichen von Borussia Dortmund gekennzeichneten Konsumgütern.

Für die BVB FanWelt in Dortmund sucht die BVB Merchandising GmbH zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Unterstützung an Spieltagen im Rahmen einer Aushilfsbeschäftigung. 

Deine Aufgaben
  • Abwicklung aller Kassiervorgänge und Umgang mit dem Kassen- & Warenwirtschaftssystem
  • Individuelle Beratung der Kunden
  • Verkauf von Waren
  • Warenpflege und -präsentation
  • Unterstützung bei Inventuren
  • Beflockung von Trikots
Dein Profil
  • Erfahrungen im Einzelhandel wünschenswert
  • Hohe Service- und Kundenorientierung
  • Selbständige Arbeitsweise
  • Sicheres und freundliches Auftreten 
  • Flexibilität, Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit
  • Verfügbarkeit an Heimspieltagen, sowohl am Wochenende als auch unter der Woche im Abendbereich
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse
Das erwartet Dich
  • Arbeiten in einem hoch emotionalen und spannenden Umfeld
  • Arbeitszeiten, die sich an Spieltagen orientieren
  • Einen Platz in einer dynamischen Mannschaft, die eine hohe Identifikation mit ihren Aufgaben mitbringt
  • Selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten

Dazu zählen neben Firmen-, Incentive- und Privatveranstaltungen aller Art auch Tagungen, Konferenzen und Messen, die auf allen Tribünen und Ebenen im Stadion stattfinden.

Für unsere Küchenbereiche im SIGNAL IDUNA PARK, im Bistro 09 sowie auf dem BVB- Trainingsgelände suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Chef Tournant (m/w/d) im Rahmen einer Vollzeitanstellung (40h/Woche).

Deine Aufgaben
  • Zubereitung von warmen und kalten Gerichten, insbesondere im Bankett und à-la-carte-Bereich sowie im Rahmen von sportgerechter Ernährung
  • Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Arbeitsablaufs in den Küchen, einschließlich der Anleitung und Führung von Fremdpersonal sowie unserer Küchenhilfen
  • Überwachung und Einhaltung der Hygienevorschriften nach dem HACCP-Konzept
  • Warenbedarfsermittlung und Annahme von Lieferungen sowie Mitwirkung bei Inventuren
  • Qualitätskontrolle der Lebensmittel und Speisen
  • Verantwortung für die fachgerechte Trennung und Entsorgung von Küchenabfällen (No waste Philosophie/Abfallminderung)

 

Dein Profil
  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Koch (m/w/d)
  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der gehobenen Hotellerie sowie Erfahrung auf der Position als Chef de Partie (m/w/d)
  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Personaldienstleistern
  • Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit, Flexibilität sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein
  • Zuverlässige, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft und Leidenschaft

 

Das erwartet Dich
  • Einen Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert
  • Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Persönliches Mitarbeiter-Ticket für unsere Heimspiele
  • Individuelle Maßnahmen zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio sowie Unterstützung für einen gesunden Arbeitsalltag
  • Weitere Mehrwerte, wie z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Dienstrad-Leasing, Team-Events, Mitarbeiter-Bistro, Altersvorsorge etc.

job.title: Manager (m/w/d) Brand Activation & Events
job.html_description:
Wir sind Borussia Dortmund. Nicht nur ein weltweit bekannter Fußballverein, sondern auch ein börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 900 Mitarbeiter*innen. Neben unserem Kerngeschäft des Fußballs sind wir in zahlreichen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern tätig. Die Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA fungiert als Dachgesellschaft für acht Tochterunternehmen.

In der Abteilung Marketing schaffen wir nicht nur unvergessliche Markenerlebnisse rund um Spieltage und Events, sondern pflegen und entwickeln auch kontinuierlich die Identität und das Design der BVB-Marke weiter. Von der strategischen Ausrichtung über die kreative Kampagnengestaltung bis hin zur individuellen Ansprache unserer Zielgruppen – unser Team entwirft innovative Marketingkonzepte, um Borussia Dortmund zum mitreißendsten Verein Europas zu machen. Das Team Brand Experience übersetzt die Identität von Borussia Dortmund in greifbare Erlebnisse.

Für die Direktion Marketing der Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Manager (m/w/d) Brand Activation & Events im Rahmen einer Vollzeitbeschäftigung (40h/Woche).

Deine Aufgaben
  • Konzeption neuer Eigenformate für die Zielgruppe der 14–23-Jährigen sowie für internationale Märkte (plattform- und kanalübergreifend).
  • Konzeption neuer Formate für Partner in enger Abstimmung mit Sponsoring/Partnermanagement – inklusive kreativer Leitideen, Aktivierungspläne und Erfolgsmessung.
  • Eigenständige Planung und Realisierung neuer und bestehender Events, Aktivierungen, Programme und Erlebnisse – von der Idee über Budget/Timing bis zur Umsetzung vor Ort.
  • Gesamtverantwortung für die Saisoneröffnung: Leitidee, Programmgestaltung, Partner- und Stakeholder-Einbindung, Produktion und operative Durchführung.
  • Agenturhandling: Briefing, Steuerung und Qualitätskontrolle externer Agenturen und Dienstleister (Kreation, Produktion, Technik).
  • Planung und Umsetzung des Spieltagsprogramms: redaktionelle Vorbereitung, Channel-Management (Stadion, App, Web, Social, Hospitality), Live-Umsetzung und Qualitätskontrolle am Spieltag.
  • Vertretung der Teamleitung bei Abwesenheit – inklusive Priorisierung, Abstimmung mit Schnittstellen und Entscheidungsfähigkeit
Dein Profil
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung (z. B. Marketing, Kommunikation, Sport-/Eventmanagement, Service/Experience Design) oder gleichwertige Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Agenturen oder auf Unternehmensebene in den Bereichen Brand/Customer Experience, Event-/Erlebnisentwicklung oder Programm-/Projektmanagement – idealerweise im Sport-, Entertainment- oder Markenumfeld
  • Du vereinst Markenverständnis, Expertise und Leidenschaft für Markenerlebnisse, Konzeptstärke und operative Exzellenz in der Umsetzung vor Ort
  • Praxis in der Entwicklung zielgruppenspezifischer Formate analog und digital (insb. Gen Z) und internationaler Adaptionen
  • Souverän in Redaktionsplanung, Channel-Management und Live-Produktion am Spieltag
  • Hohe Affinität zu Fußball, insbesondere zu Borussia Dortmund und unsere Tradition
  • Starke Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch; überzeugendes Stakeholder- und Agenturmanagement
  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft an Spieltagen/Abenden/Wochenenden
Das erwartet Dich
  • Ein Platz in einem dynamischen Team, das sich stark mit seinen Aufgaben identifiziert
  • Spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeiten in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel eigenverantwortlicher Gestaltungsspielraum 
  • Persönliches Mitarbeiter-Ticket für unsere Heimspiele
  • Individuelle Maßnahmen zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio sowie Unterstützung für einen gesunden Arbeitsalltag
  • Weitere Mehrwerte, wie z. B. flexible Arbeitszeiten, Dienstrad-Leasing, Team-Events, Mitarbeiter-Bistro, Altersvorsorge etc.
Jetzt bewerben
