job.title: Talent Pool – People with Disabilities | 8 Host Cities
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) which will be hosted for the first time ever in South America, Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

This is an exclusive talent pool initiative for people with disabilities, as part of our commitment to inclusive hiring.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible working environment. As part of this commitment, we are launching an affirmative hiring initiative exclusively for people with disabilities to build a talent pool of professionals interested in contributing to the delivery of one of the world’s largest sporting events.

This initiative aims to connect talented individuals with potential opportunities across different divisions and functional areas of the tournament. We welcome candidates with a range of professional backgrounds, skills, and experiences, including those looking to apply their transferable skills in a new environment.

Candidates may be considered for future opportunities based on their qualifications, experience, skills, interests, preferred location, and the specific requirements of each position.

We are committed to an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Reasonable accommodations can be requested at any stage of the process.

Administration 
  • Anti Doping
  • Event Controlling
  • Sustainability & Human Rights
  • Volunteer Management
  • Workforce Management
Operations
  • Access Management
  • Accreditation
  • Catering
  • Cleaning & Waste Management
  • Competition Management
  • Dressing & Signage
  • Engineering
  • Event Logistics
  • Event Transport
  • Fan Services
  • Guest Operations
  • Host Broadcast Production
  • Media Operations & Services
  • Medical
  • Overlay
  • Referee Services
  • Safety & Security
  • Stadium Entertainment
  • Team Services
  • Technology
Revenues & Marketing 
  • Event Marketing
  • Hospitality
  • Partner Rights Delivery
  • Partnership Management
Experience & Skills
  • Education and/or professional experience relevant to the area of interest. Previous experience in events, sports, hospitality, logistics, customer service, administration, or related fields may be an advantage, depending on the position.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, adaptability, and willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and multicultural environment.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion, where relevant to the position.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese.
  • English proficiency may be required for some opportunities. 
  • Familiarity with MS Office tools, such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, may be desirable for certain positions.
Location & Availability
  • Potential opportunities may be available across the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 host cities, including Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Belo Horizonte, Salvador, Recife, Fortaleza, Brasília, and Porto Alegre. 
  • Work arrangements, contract duration, start dates, and availability requirements will depend on the specific position and operational needs of the tournament and venues.

FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 is a proud equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and prohibits discrimination of any kind on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We encourage candidates to share any accessibility requirements they would like us to consider during the process. Requests will be handled with care and discretion.

job.title: Venue Telecom Manager – 8 Host Cities
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. 

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Venue Telecom Manager (VTCM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The VTCM will work closely with the Technology teams in all the stadiums and IBCC and Zurich, as well as other stakeholders, to deliver critical Network and telecommunications solutions for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of telecommunications infrastructure and services across competition and non-competition venues, including:
    o   Broadcast Contribution Network (BCN)
    o   Event Network (WAN, MAN, LAN, WLAN, cabling, containment)
    o   Internet, VLAN, VPN services
    o   Mobile Network and Private 5G
    o   Push-to-Talk/Private Mobile Radios
    o   Spectrum Management
    o   CATV/IPTV
    o   Rate Card services (Internet/IP Codecs)
  • Deploy and oversee technology services across various venues.
  • Stadia, training sites, operation centers, accreditation centers, ticketing centers, hotels, airports, and transport hubs.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA standards in the integration of tournament technology services, such as Accreditation and Ticketing, with the FIFA Event Network environment.
  • Collaborate with Football Technology Innovation suppliers, media, broadcasters, and other functional stakeholders to define and fulfill network and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Coordinate on-site IT and telecom technical teams for infrastructure testing, acceptance, and operations.
  • Manage incident resolution and ensure adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs), escalating risks and issues to the Technology Command Center (TCC).
  • Support spectrum management efforts, including interference resolution in collaboration with regulatory authorities and venue teams.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting, including daily updates to the TCC and post-event analysis.
  • Participate in pre-tournament training, readiness exercises, and rehearsals.
Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field.
Experience
  • Relevant IT/Technology experience, preferably in major events.
  • Strong knowledge of IT and telecommunications technologies, including IPTV, AV systems, radio communications, VLANs and related areas.
  • Experience coordinating with diverse teams and managing vendor relationships.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred

Ideal skills 
  • Manager with experience in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events 
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, IPTV, radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual. 
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee. 
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones  
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members 
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance  
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or willing to relocate.

job.title: Law Clerk Commercial & Event Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:

  • A role within the commercial legal team, which supports the delivery of legal services relating to FIFA’s global commercial operations.
  • Assist the commercial legal team in advising the various FIFA business functions in their everyday operations.
  • Assisting in drafting, negotiating and advising on a broad range of commercial media partnerships matters connected with FIFA’s revenue generating activities, including FIFA’s sports marketing, licensing, agency appointments and media promotions.
  • Providing support regarding the interpretation of a range of media, rights, marketing, IP and technology agreements.
  • Assist in providing legal support related to social media and digital content related matters.
  • Providing legal and contractual support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities.
  • Supporting the exploitation of commercial opportunities on FIFA+ and FIFA’s other digital channels.
  • Assist in providing advice, guidance and support for all legal, regulatory and governance matters relating to FIFA’s commercial media activities.
  • Developing and maintaining FIFA’s template agreements.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements.
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice.
  • Excellent understanding of the sports marketing, sports merchandising, licensing, retail, digital marketing, sponsorship, licensing, e-commerce and business intelligence industry landscapes.
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Structured, reliable, well-organized with a strong eye for detail.
  • Ability to perform consistently within a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals.
  • Strong commercial acumen with an ability to transfer legal knowledge into commercially and operationally oriented solutions.
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects.
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities.
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills.
  • High degree of professionalism and confident demeanor.
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior legal counsels as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone.
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist the organization and internal clients.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from a top tier accredited US law school.
  • Active US bar membership is required.
  • 2-3 years expertise in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on media, rights, sports or IP matters.
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice.

  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel.
  • Comfortable with international travel.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Event Marketing Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). 


Reporting organisationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro) and the Team Lead, Event Marketing (FIFA HQ, Zurich), the Event Marketing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotion team, and will work in close collaboration with the Event Marketing in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for all marketing campaigns for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the creation and implementation of strategic, high impact, end-to-end marketing campaigns to meet and exceed the objectives of the Tournament
  • In line with the wider FIFA27 and FIFA Zurich teams, define and manage comprehensive GTM multi-channel marketing plans (in close liaison with the digital marketing, ticketing, comms, BI, and brand teams) to support strategic goals to drive awareness, attendance, engagement and retainment
  • Liaise directly with internal and external tournament stakeholders as required including Host Cities and Stadiums, Commercial Partners, and Official Media Partners and Licensees to amplify campaigns.
  • Support the development of cross cultural and sector tactical and long-term 
    strategical promotional partnerships with partners and third parties for mutual benefit
  • Create and circulate relevant briefing, publishing plans, planning, valuation, tracking and final reporting documents related to marketing stakeholder’s needs as required
  • Implement influencer strategies in support of marketing objectives. Including mapping of influencers/ambassadors/legends/celebrities and identified events and potentially on-site management/support
  • Ad-hoc support of additional workstreams in relation to event marketing needs which may include contact/planning/liaising with football clubs or participating member associations (PMA’s)
  • Co-Develop launches of major brand assets, such as tournament logos, mascots, posters, and songs, as well as oversee multi-stage global and localised awareness and tournament related sales campaigns 
  • Become an expert in FIFA event marketing milestone planning and challenge the status quo and norm with new and creative marketing milestone concepts to ensure amplification and data capture
  • Provide stakeholders with timely and accurate information on promotional and marketing events, activations and opportunities and ensure stakeholders to drive optimisation of the opportunities.
Education
  • Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education.
Skills & Competencies
  • Adaptable, effective and efficient under pressure, immovable deadlines, and in stressful situations 
  • Effective at working proactively and independently whilst providing regular updates, being able to communicate clearly and effectively via different channels with key stakeholders
  • Ability to convey ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders
  • Willingness to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed
  • Knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture and trends
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail in all tasks and deliverables
Work Experience
  • Experience with delivering major brand and marketing plans, and favourable to hold experience with sport's governing bodies, LOCs and, or sports and entertainment rightsholders
  • Deep familiarity and understanding of the dynamics of football
  • Well-connected with existing connections with Key Stakeholders, Partners (Qualified Clubs, Leagues, Associations)
  • Experience in Brand Marketing and Marketing Operations, Communications, Events
  • A passion for football
Technology
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), planning software and online collaboration tools (Monday.com) 
Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Legal Assistant Judicial Bodies
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team as a freelancer and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Supporting other members of the Disciplinary team in the preparation of case files for decision by the FIFA Judicial Bodies.
  • Providing administrative and operational support to the Disciplinary Department, including the preparation of agendas, reports, statistics and correspondence.
  • Monitoring the departmental inbox and case management system and ensuring the timely processing and follow-up of incoming matters.
  • Supporting the administrative aspects of disciplinary proceedings, including the opening and maintenance of cases, preparation of case files, drafting of opening letters, notification of correspondence, implementation and monitoring of sanctions, and coordination of document translations.
  • Maintaining, updating and archiving records and case-related data across the relevant systems and platforms.
  • Coordinating hearings, meetings and other Judicial Bodies events, including logistical arrangements such as travel, accommodation, interpretation services and visa support.
  • Processing invoices and expense claims, recording fines and suspensions, and supporting the publication of decisions.
  • Assisting with disciplinary proceedings during FIFA competitions, including handling procedural correspondence and providing support during periods of increased activity, which may occasionally include weekends.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • University degree; a degree in law, legal studies or a related field would be an asset.
  • Minimum three years of relevant experience, with a strong administrative background.
  • Good planning and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of basic principles of law.
  • Knowledge of sports law and, specifically, football law.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish and/or French.
  • Proficient in MS Office.
  • Experience with the Transfer Matching System (TMS), FIFA Legal Portal and/or JIRA would be an asset.
  • Detail-oriented, with excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Autonomous and committed to excellence, positively contributing to the efficiency and quality of work and ensuring an optimal service to stakeholders.
  • Self-confident and diplomatic.
  • Proactive and solution-driven.
  • Innovative, with a strong ability to embrace change and new technologies/processes.
  • Flexible and adaptable.
  • Able to set priorities effectively and work under pressure.
  • Team player who is professional, approachable, empathic and cooperative.

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Support the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Coordinate and execute workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work closely with the FIFA Workforce Management team to support an integrated planning process, ensuring resources align with operational needs and service levels
• Assist in defining workforce categories and supporting the development of entitlements for each group
• Maintain and update the centralised headcount plan, ensuring data accuracy and accessibility
• Support change management activities to enable continuity in workforce planning and execution
• Contribute inputs to workforce budgets, timelines, and planning cycles

Workforce Operations & Management
• Help develop and execute operational plans for workforce delivery during tournament time, including supporting site operations
• Assist in defining requirements for physical spaces, overlay, technology, and other workforce-related needs on site
• Develop workforce policies & procedures with key operational stakeholders (transport, accommodation, catering etc.) and core central business areas such as HR, technology, finance. 
• Define and map out key workforce planning & operational processes, understanding the cross-functional collaboration required.
• Support the coordination of business processes and system requirements for workforce operations tools
• Deliver role-specific and venue-specific training for workforce operations teams
• Support the day-to-day supervision, scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including workforce and volunteers
• Provide operational support to venue managers during event delivery

  • Work Experience
    • Experience in workforce planning or operations, ideally within international events and/or the sports industry
    • Good working knowledge of workforce planning systems, tools, and practices
    • Experience supporting or coordinating operational venue teams at large-scale events
    • Understanding of data-driven decision-making and workforce planning processes in complex environments
    • Demonstrated ability to manage projects, prioritise tasks effectively, and work with a level of independence
    • Experience supervising team members and contributing to team performance through positive leadership and collaboration
    • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability, with experience supporting discussions, problem-solving, and stakeholder coordination
    • Experience working in a multicultural and/or multinational environment
    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken  
    • Fluent/Advanced Portuguese

  • Technology
    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Legal Counsel Commercial Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
The Legal Counsel will be an active member of the Commercial Legal Team working with various Senior Legal Counsels, the Head of Content & Media and the Director of Commercial Legal to
support the delivery of legal services relating to FIFA’s global operations.

The role of Legal Counsel will support some, or all, of the business functions within FIFA’s global operations, such as the following:

  • Assisting the commercial teams by advising on their everyday operations
  • Assisting in drafting, negotiating and advising on a broad range of commercial and media partnerships matters connected with FIFA’s revenue generating activities
  • Providing support regarding the interpretation of a range of media, rights, marketing, IP, retail and licensing, agency appointments, consumer promotions and technology agreements
  • Assisting in providing legal support related to Web3 activities, social media, digital content, gaming and e-sports related matters
  • Providing legal and contractual support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities
  • Providing legal and contractual support on the exploitation of commercial opportunities on FIFA’s digital platforms
  • Supporting FIFA’s subsidiaries, including the FIFA Museum and the FIFA Foundation regarding the exploitation of commercial opportunities within FIFA’s commercial framework
  • Providing advice, guidance and support for all legal, regulatory and governance matters relating to FIFA’s commercial media activities
  • Providing legal support and counsel on development and production deal structures and documentation for internal and third-party projects, including advising on pre-production and coproduction deals
  • Assisting in managing, developing and maintaining FIFA's portfolio of non-live content related templates
  • Assisting and providing support for the FIFA Technology team in support of the upcoming major FIFA tournaments worldwide
  • Assisting and providing support for the FIFA Innovation team in support of the upcoming major FIFA tournaments worldwide
  • Providing legal support for music related matters (both live and recorded music)
  • Instructing and liaising with external counsel in connection with local law matters in various jurisdictions
  • Developing and maintaining FIFA’s template agreements
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

This role would suit someone with great communication skills who is a dedicated team player and excels in being professional with excellent legal skills.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Ability to participate and be part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice
  • Excellent understanding of the sports marketing, sports merchandising, licensing, retail, digital marketing, sponsorship, licensing, e-commerce and business intelligence industry landscapes
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Structured, reliable, with a strong eye for detail
  • Ability to perform consistently within a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • Strong commercial acumen with an ability to transfer legal knowledge into commercially and operationally oriented solutions
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confidence
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist internal clients
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school
  • Active bar membership is required
  • 4-6 years expertise in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on technology, media, sports or IP matters
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish/Portuguese) is an asset but not required
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook / Word / PowerPoint / Excel / Teams
  • Comfortable with international travel
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Ticketing General Public Customer Care Analyst
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing CRM Senior Manager and the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Coordinator, the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Analyst will support Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will be responsible for the implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of the customer care strategies and processes for General Public Customers, ensuring compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations. The Customer Care Analyst focuses particularly on the analysis and performance optimization of ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027, with a focus on both national and international clients. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the design and monitor the performance of customer care strategies and processes across all communication channels established (contact forms, call centers, chatbot, emails, etc.), flagging adjustments needed for consistency and effectiveness. 
  • Support the Customer Care Manager in overseeing outsourced customer care and call center service providers, monitoring service setups and delivery against agreed requirements and service levels. 
  • Support the design of training content and monitor training completion and effectiveness for customer care staff and call center teams, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations. 
  • Review and validate customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) on a sample basis to ensure adherence to standards. 
  • Monitor adherence to escalation processes across teams and report on deviations for correction. 
  • Design and implement quality control procedures to detect deviations from requirements early and flag them for timely correction. 
  • Support the design, implementation and ongoing optimization of automated and manual case management processes within the CRM systems in use. 
  • Analyze customer care and call center performance data to identify opportunities to increase agent productivity and customer satisfaction, and support the implementation of resulting solutions. 
  • Proactively identify and report on patterns and risks, and support the design of processes to mitigate them. 
  • Monitor and report on Customer Care process compliance with FIFA functional area requirements (Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.), flagging gaps for resolution. 
  • Analyze and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care and call center services, using CRM and other systems. 
  • Coordinate the quality assurance checks performed across the customer care operation and consolidate findings into regular reporting. 
  • Maintain version control and archiving of the customer care and call center knowledge base, across all languages, ensuring accuracy and accessibility. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.   
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents. 
 
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.     

WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Experience working within large, multicultural operational structures (in-house staff and external service providers), collaborating toward a shared operational goal. 
  •  Experience supporting Ticketing Customer Care operations on major international sports events, with exposure to recruitment, training and project delivery processes. 
  •  Experience planning, monitoring and analysing ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects; prior exposure to International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups, is an advantage. 
  •  Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or sport events. 
  •  Experience in an analytical or customer care operations role during previous FIFA World Cups or comparable major international sports events is advantageous. 
  •  Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, able to work effectively within multicultural teams. 
  •  Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
LANGUAGES

Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous.

TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  •  CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.

job.title: Volunteer Platform Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Volunteer Systems Manager, the Volunteer Systems Coordinator will actively participate in the design, development, and implementation of the Volunteer Management System for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The successful candidate must demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and a strong ability to solve complex problems, particularly in the context of volunteerism and database management systems. In addition to managing system integrations that are crucial for an efficient volunteer journey, the role requires collaboration across the Volunteer department to ensure that the technology platforms meet contractual requirements and support critical business processes effectively.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Support the Volunteer Systems Manager in ensuring all technical requirements are captured, documented, and addressed within the Volunteer Management System.
  • Assist in defining and refining volunteer journey requirements across all modules of the volunteer management system, including Recruitment, Assignments, Scheduling, Rostering, Training, Accreditation and Uniform Distribution, and tournament Operations.
  • Support with the development and defining the integration matrix mapping necessary for all relevant systems, ensuring seamless connectivity and data flow across platforms.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of system training materials and assist with training sessions for system user.s. This involves prioritizing user requests, managing deadlines, and defining essential system reports to support operational needs.
  • Coordinate the development and delivery of the system to meet all required specifications. Provide ongoing problem resolution and support following the go-live date to ensure seamless system performance.
  • Contribute innovative ideas to improve and optimize system workflows.
  • Work in close collaboration with internal FIFA Functional Areas and Host Cities to help ensure the successful development, implementation and management of the Volunteer Management System.
  • Identify and report system-related issues and diligently follow up to ensure their resolution or escalate as necessary to mitigate potential impacts.
  • Support with planning and delivery for the Official Draw, Playoffs and other readiness workshops.
Responsibilities of the role will likely evolve during the lifespan of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, and the successful candidate should be supportive and flexible to additional requirements.
  • Strong experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Desired - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field.
  • Efficient communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to follow governance processes, manage change requests, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Adaptable to work across multiple teams, locations, and time zones.
  • Ability to balance priorities whilst working in a fast-moving progressive environment.
  • Strong team player, adaptable to working under tight timelines, and ready to step in wherever needed to drive success, with a commitment to delivering results without compromising quality.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong proficiency in using technology, including the Office 365 suite and industry-specific software.
  • Experienced in working with various Event Management Systems and/or Volunteer Management Systems.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Legal Counsel Event Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.

The Event Legal team at FIFA is responsible for providing legal advice and support on the organization and hosting of FIFA’s tournaments and events around the world including the FIFA World Cup™, FIFA Women’s World Cup™, FIFA Club World Cup™ and all other FIFA tournaments and events including youth, futsal and beach soccer tournaments.  The Event Legal team supports divisions across FIFA, with a focus on supporting the World Cup, Women’s Football and Tournaments and Competitions divisions.
These are your key tasks:
  • Developing and implementing the legal framework for the hosting and staging of FIFA tournaments and events, including:
    • drafting and advising on the implementation of hosting agreements, host city agreements, stadium agreements, training site agreements, airport agreements, accommodation agreements and related contractual documentation; and
    • supervising the implementation of guarantees from Governments of host countries across topics such as taxation, immigration, employment and customs, including implementing legislative changes as necessary.
  • Supporting the bidding process for the hosting and staging of FIFA tournaments and events, including undertaking the legal evaluation of bids received from potential host countries.
  • Planning and implementing, in collaboration with FIFA Finance, the tax and corporate structures of FIFA subsidiaries in host countries of FIFA tournaments and events.
  • Providing legal support to establish initial operational functionality of FIFA subsidiaries in host countries of FIFA tournaments and events, including developing the legal strategy for the ongoing provision of legal support to such FIFA subsidiaries.
  • Providing legal services and support to the Ticketing division, including advising on contracts for the procurement of ticketing systems and services, ticketing terms and conditions and assessment of local laws and their impact on FIFA’s ticketing strategies.
  • Providing legal services and support to the Hospitality division, including advising on contracts for the procurement of hospitality sales and production services, hospitality terms and conditions and assessment of local laws and their impact on FIFA’s hospitality programs.
  • Providing legal services and support to the Accommodation division, including advising on contracts for the procurement of hotels for use across stakeholder groups in connection with FIFA tournaments and events.
  • Providing legal services and support in respect of FIFA’s tournament and event regulations, including Competition Regulations, Media & Marketing Regulations and Equipment Regulations.
  • Advising on local laws in host countries and their impact on the delivery of FIFA’s tournaments and events.
  • Coordinating and working closely with other legal divisions within FIFA in relation to the hosting and staging of FIFA tournament and events, including in relation to media rights, TV production, content, music, technology, intellectual property, brand protection, sponsorship, marketing, corporate and institutional matters.
  • Engaging and managing external legal counsel.
 
The successful candidate will build relationships with internal stakeholders and provide excellence in the delivery of legal services by following a solutions-based approach. This role will have a significant international focus as FIFA’s tournaments and events are hosted and staged and around the world and the successful candidate will work with and manage stakeholders in countries around the world.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience of legal practice in a leading law firm or in-house with a major corporate.
  • Previous experience of legal experience in the sports industry is desirable, particularly experience with the bidding, hosting and staging of major sports events, including in relation to the hosting contracts, ticketing, hospitality and accommodation.  
  • Candidates with a demonstrable interest in the sports industry and a strong commercial legal background will also be considered.
  • Fully qualified to practice law (registered on the roll / admitted to the bar of the relevant jurisdiction) having completed academic and practical training.
  • Substantial professional experience of working with and drafting legal documents in English, including legal agreements for the provision of services.
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements. 
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice. 
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Structured, reliable, well-organized with a strong eye for detail. 
  • Ability to work as part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals.
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects.
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities. 
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills.
  • High degree of professionalism and confident demeanor.
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA Senior Management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone.
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist the organization and internal clients.
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice. 
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish/German) is an asset but not necessary.
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel.
  • Willingness to travel. 
  • Willingness to work in host country settings when required.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Fan Services Venue Manager - 7 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. 

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) will take place in June and July 2027 across eight stadiums in Brazil.

Reporting to the Fan Services Manager, the Fan Services Venue Manager is responsible for delivering a world‑class fan experience at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This role, initially, supports the planning, coordination, and delivery of fan services across all venues, ensuring that spectators enjoy a safe, welcoming, and seamless experience from arrival to departure. 

The Fan Services Venue Manager acts as the primary point of contact for all key fan service deliverables within stadium operations, ensuring consistency and compliance with agreed service standards across the tournament.

This role requires effective management of spectator services, close coordination with FIFA Functional Areas and stadium teams, and strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key focus areas include clear communication, problem‑solving, innovation, issue escalation, transparency, and the use of reporting tools to ensure operational excellence.

The Fan Services Venue Manager is responsible for the planning, preparation, and delivery of fan services of a specific stadium, including:

Operational Planning & Service Delivery 
  • Responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of Fan Services operations at the assigned stadium, including spectator information points, wayfinding and guidance, accessibility and mobility assistance, stroller storage, and other spectator support services. 
  • Ensure the delivery of welcoming and inclusive fan experience, by implementing efficient Fan Services operations that comply and meet FIFA service standards, respond to spectator needs, and align with the defined project scope and the overall FWWC2027 programme.
  • Oversee the setup, operational readiness, management, and dismantling of fan service spaces, assets, Technology Equipment (TEAP), Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E), and related logistics.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management
  • Work closely with stadium Venue Management, Security, Ticketing, Volunteer Management, Hospitality, Dressing & Signage and other teams to integrate tournament operations with existing stadium services ensuring coordinated spectator flows, and integrated resolution of fans needs throughout the matchday journey.
  • Coordinate with FIFA Functional Areas, stadium operators, local authorities and external stakeholders to support Last Mile operations, ensuring clear wayfinding, and a safe, smooth spectator journey to and from the stadium.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with FIFA Functional Areas, stadium operators, service providers, and other relevant stakeholders. Confidently lead cross-functional meetings, navigate competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment in balancing collaboration with constructive challenge to ensure decisions support Fan Services operational needs and objectives. 
Workforce & Project Management.
  • Lead, coordinate, train and oversee Fan Services staff and volunteer teams, ensuring effective deployment, operational readiness, team welfare, and the consistent delivery of high-quality spectator services throughout stadium operations.
  • Maintain close coordination with the Fan Services Central Team through regular operational meetings, providing progress updates, tracking deliverables on Monday.com, addressing challenges, and ensuring alignment between stadium-level planning and tournament-wide Fan Services strategies and standards.
  • Ensure timely and accurate completion of WeTrack reporting requirements, including pre-tournament readiness reports, post-match reports, and tournament debriefings. 
Matchday Operations & Incident Management
  • Oversee all Fan Services operations on matchdays, ensuring the effective implementation of established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, and operational protocols. Proactively identify and mitigate operational risks, resolve issues within the scope of responsibility, and escalate incidents through the appropriate reporting lines when required. 

Education
  • University degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Sports Management, Business Administration, or a related field relevant to the role,or equivalent vocational qualifications and professional experience. 
  •  Advanced proficiency or fluency in both spoken and written Brazilian Portuguese and English is required.
  • Strong administrative, and ITskills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Previous experience with project management tools, such as Monday.com, as well as WeTrack, is considered an asset.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Fan Services, Event/Venue Operations, Hospitality, or other relevant operational roles, preferably within major sporting events, international events, or large-scale public events. 
  • Proven experience coordinating operations or service delivery in dynamic, multi-stakeholder environments, working with internal teams, external partners, local authorities, and service providers.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and coordinating teams, including workforce planning, deployment, supervision, and team engagement. Previous experience managing large groups of staff or volunteers is considered an advantage.
  • Familiarity with crowd management principles, particularly within sporting events is an asset.
  • Solid understanding of event planning and project management methodologies. 
  • Strong presentation, negotiation and leadership skills. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead cross‑functional teams. 
  • Strong crisis‑management capability with the ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure. 
  • Familiarity with host stadium operations is considered an asset. 
Skills & Competencies
  • Ability to manage priorities, adapt to changing operational needs, and deliver responsibilities within agreed timelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain adaptable, proactive, and solution-focused in high-pressure operational environments.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) will take place in June and July 2027 across eight stadiums in Brazil.
Reporting to the Fan Services Manager, the Fan Services Venue Manager is responsible for delivering a world‑class fan experience at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This role, initially, supports the planning, coordination, and delivery of fan services across all venues, ensuring that spectators enjoy a safe, welcoming, and seamless experience from arrival to departure.
The Fan Services Venue Manager acts as the primary point of contact for all key fan service deliverables within stadium operations, ensuring consistency and compliance with agreed service standards across the tournament.
This role requires effective management of spectator services, close coordination with FIFA Functional Areas and stadium teams, and strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key focus areas include clear communication, problem‑solving, innovation, issue escalation, transparency, and the use of reporting tools to ensure operational excellence.
The Fan Services Venue Manager is responsible for the planning, preparation, and delivery of fan services of a specific stadium, including:
Operational Planning & Service Delivery
- Responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of Fan Services operations at the assigned stadium, including spectator information points, wayfinding and guidance, accessibility and mobility assistance, stroller storage, and other spectator support services. - Ensure the delivery of welcoming and inclusive fan experience, by implementing efficient Fan Services operations that comply and meet FIFA service standards, respond to spectator needs, and align with the defined project scope and the overall FWWC2027 programme. - Oversee the setup, operational readiness, management, and dismantling of fan service spaces, assets, Technology Equipment (TEAP), Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E), and related logistics. - Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management - Work closely with stadium Venue Management, Security, Ticketing, Volunteer Management, Hospitality, Dressing & Signage and other teams to integrate tournament operations with existing stadium services ensuring coordinated spectator flows, and integrated resolution of fans needs throughout the matchday journey. - Coordinate with FIFA Functional Areas, stadium operators, local authorities and external stakeholders to support Last Mile operations, ensuring clear wayfinding, and a safe, smooth spectator journey to and from the stadium. - Build and maintain effective working relationships with FIFA Functional Areas, stadium operators, service providers, and other relevant stakeholders. Confidently lead cross-functional meetings, navigate competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment in balancing collaboration with constructive challenge to ensure decisions support Fan Services operational needs and objectives.
Workforce & Project Management.
- Lead, coordinate, train and oversee Fan Services staff and volunteer teams, ensuring effective deployment, operational readiness, team welfare, and the consistent delivery of high-quality spectator services throughout stadium operations. - Maintain close coordination with the Fan Services Central Team through regular operational meetings, providing progress updates, tracking deliverables on Monday.com, addressing challenges, and ensuring alignment between stadium-level planning and tournament-wide Fan Services strategies and standards. - Ensure timely and accurate completion of WeTrack reporting requirements, including pre-tournament readiness reports, post-match reports, and tournament debriefings.
Matchday Operations & Incident Management
- Oversee all Fan Services operations on matchdays, ensuring the effective implementation of established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, and operational protocols. Proactively identify and mitigate operational risks, resolve issues within the scope of responsibility, and escalate incidents through the appropriate reporting lines when required.
Education
- University degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Sports Management, Business Administration, or a related field relevant to the role,or equivalent vocational qualifications and professional experience. - Advanced proficiency or fluency in both spoken and written Brazilian Portuguese and English is required. - Strong administrative, and ITskills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). - Previous experience with project management tools, such as Monday.com, as well as WeTrack, is considered an asset.
Experience
- Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Fan Services, Event/Venue Operations, Hospitality, or other relevant operational roles, preferably within major sporting events, international events, or large-scale public events. - Proven experience coordinating operations or service delivery in dynamic, multi-stakeholder environments, working with internal teams, external partners, local authorities, and service providers. - Demonstrated experience leading and coordinating teams, including workforce planning, deployment, supervision, and team engagement. Previous experience managing large groups of staff or volunteers is considered an advantage. - Familiarity with crowd management principles, particularly within sporting events is an asset. - Solid understanding of event planning and project management methodologies. - Strong presentation, negotiation and leadership skills. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. - Ability to work independently and lead cross‑functional teams. - Strong crisis‑management capability with the ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure. - Familiarity with host stadium operations is considered an asset.
Skills & Competencies
- Ability to manage priorities, adapt to changing operational needs, and deliver responsibilities within agreed timelines. - Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain adaptable, proactive, and solution-focused in high-pressure operational environments. - Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads during busy periods. - Excellent interpersonal skills across diverse stakeholder groups. - Cultural awareness and sensitivity, including individuals with disabilities, reduced mobility, and different accessibility or support needs. Certifications & Requirements Right to work in Brazil.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) will take place in June and July 2027 across eight stadiums in Brazil.

Reporting to the Fan Services Manager, the Fan Services Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, implementation and delivery of Fan Services operations for the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™. 

During the planning phase, the role supports the central Fan Services team in workforce planning, training, venue readiness, procurement, stakeholder coordination and spectator experience initiatives. 

During Tournament Time, the role may be deployed to Maracana Stadium to support the delivery of stadium Fan Services operations, workforce management and spectator-facing services.


The Fan Services Coordinator is responsible for supporting the planning, preparation, and delivery of fan services:

  • Assist the Fan Services Central Team with the preparation and coordination of operational plans, service standards and the overall FWWC2027 programme, including documentation, updates, and follow-up on related activities. Support workforce and volunteer planning, scheduling and deployment, including the coordination of onboarding materials, tasks, and activities for Fan Services staff and volunteers, assisting with training and following up on workforce readiness requirements across all stadiums.
  • Assist the Central Fan Services Team in maintaining and updating project trackers, operational reports, and relevant documentation. 
  • Support with procurement coordination, and the planning and tracking of Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E) requirements, including maintaining material lists, monitoring procurement and delivery status, and following up with relevant service providers. 
  • Contribute to venue-level Fan Services test event preparations and readiness exercises.
  • Liaise with FIFA Functional Areas and external stakeholders to gather operational information, coordinate meetings, follow up on outstanding requests, and track action points related to Fan Services planning and delivery across all stadiums.
  • Support review of spectator journeys and Fan Services locations across different venues, including reviewing stadium maps, identifying potential operational challenges, documenting feedback, and tracking necessary adjustments with Venue Managers and relevant Functional Areas.
  • During Tournament Time, contribute to the delivery of Fan Services operations at assigned venue(s), including the coordination of Information Points, volunteer activities, and operational reporting, working closely with Venue Managers to ensure smooth matchday operations. 


Education

  • University degree or vocational qualification in Event Management, Hospitality, Sports Management, Business Administration, Project Management, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
  • Fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English, both written and spoken, are required. Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years experience in Event Operations, Hospitality, Customer Service, Project Coordination, Logistics, Workforce or Volunteer Coordination, or other relevant administrative and operational roles, particularly within major sporting events, international events, or large-scale public events is considered an advantage.
  • Experience coordinating meetings, tracking action points and deadlines, maintaining operational documentation, and following up with internal teams, external stakeholders, and service providers. 
  • Familiarity with project management tools, particularly Monday.com, is desirable. 
  • Previous experience coordinating volunteer or staff onboarding, training activities, scheduling, deployment arrangements, and maintaining workforce records is desirable.
  • Good understanding of event planning and project coordination processes, including task tracking, timeline management, documentation, and follow-up on operational deliverables.
  • Strong presentation skills. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to coordinate activities, follow up on action points, and meet deadlines.
  • Familiarity with host stadiums operations is considered an asset. 
  • Flexibility and adaptability in dynamic and evolving environments. 
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong team player with  a collaborative approach and the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Proactive and Solution-oriented mindset  with the ability to remain calm and adaptable under pressure.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads during busy periods.
  • Sound judgment and critical problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently, and follow through on assigned tasks and responsibilities. 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity, with experience in international contexts.
Certifications & Requirements

Right to work in Brazil.

job.title: Accreditation System and Application Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The accreditation system is a core operational platform enabling secure access management, badge production, and service delivery across all venues and facilities.

The Accreditation System & Applications Coordinator plays a central operational leadership role in delivering, supporting, and managing the accreditation system throughout all tournament phases.

Reporting to the Accreditation System & Applications Manager, the Accreditation System & Applications Coordinator supports the operational delivery and day‑to‑day management of the accreditation system for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

The role focuses on system support, user assistance, documentation, and execution, ensuring the system operates accurately and reliably throughout planning and tournament operations.

The Accreditation System and Application Coordinator will be a key member of the FIFA27 Accreditation Team and is responsible for providing technical support for accreditation processes and systems. This position will assist the Accreditation System and Application Manager with system-related operations. The role requires strong organisational skills, technical proficiency, and the ability to work in a dynamic, multicultural environment. 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
System Support & Operations
  • Support system readiness activities across all phases, including setup, application, validation, production, and distribution.
  • Provide first‑level system support to accreditation users and stakeholders.
  • Monitor system usage and support issue identification and resolution.
User Support & Training
  • Assist in delivering system training sessions to Client Group teams, Operations teams, and venue users.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of user manuals, quick guides, and FAQs.
  • Support communication of system updates and changes to users.
Data & Process Support
  • Support data management activities, including validation and quality checks.
  • Assist with tracking access rights assignment and operational workflows within the system.
  • Support reporting and extraction of system data as required.
Operational & Event‑Time Support
  • Support live system operations during test events and tournament time.
  • Assist with real‑time issue logging and resolution coordination.
  • Escalate technical issues to the System & Applications Manager as required.
Accreditation System and Application Support
  • Report to Accreditation System and Application Manager on all FIFA Accreditation System related matters.
  • Support system readiness across all phases: setup, application, validation, production and distribution
  • Provide technical support to all types of system users and stakeholder groups.
  • Assist in delivering training for system users, including venue teams and client group management teams. 
  • Maintain updated user manuals, process documents, and FAQs. 
Education & Experience
  • Experience in accreditation or client services at major international events.
  • Strong understanding of access control, zoning, and accreditation systems.
  • Proven ability to work in a multicultural, fast-paced environment.
Skills & Competencies
  • Ability to quickly learn and accurately document new processes.
  • Skilled in capturing key decisions and action points in a clear, structured manner.
  • Confident in building relationships and communicating effectively with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
  • Comfortable presenting ideas and updates to groups of varying sizes.
  • High attention to detail and data management
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities effectively.
  • Proficiency in accreditation software and Microsoft Office tools. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Accreditation Client Group Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of accreditation services for designated client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Working closely with Client Group Managers, Accreditation Systems, Security, Venue teams, and other functional areas, the role focuses on data accuracy, process execution, stakeholder support, and operational readiness. 

The position plays a critical role in ensuring that client group accreditation applications are processed correctly, access rights are applied accurately, and services are delivered in line with FIFA accreditation policies and service standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Group Support & Coordination
  • Support accreditation delivery for assigned client groups, such as volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners, workforce, or other tournament stakeholders.
  • Assist in collecting, reviewing, and validating client group accreditation data in line with eligibility criteria and submission timelines.
  • Maintain regular communication with client group contacts to provide guidance on accreditation requirements, processes, and deadlines.
  • Coordinate closely with Client Group Managers to support overall client group readiness and service delivery.
Accreditation Process Execution
  • Support the end‑to‑end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including application tracking, data validation, approval support, badge status monitoring, and distribution preparation.
  • Assist with the accurate assignment and verification of access rights in accordance with FIFA zoning concepts, venue access matrices, and security protocols.
  • Monitor application progress and highlight issues, inconsistencies, or risks to the Client Group Manager. 
Stakeholder & Functional Area Support
  • Assist in liaising with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to communicate accreditation guidelines and data requirements.
  • Support the preparation of guidance materials, instructions, and training documentation for client groups and venue teams.
  • Provide operational support to venue accreditation teams as required.
Event-Time Operations
  • Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points during test events and tournament time.
  • Assist with client service at accreditation centres, including troubleshooting data issues and supporting badge collection processes.
  • Support coordination with Security, Venue Operations, and Accreditation Operations teams to address access‑related issues promptly.
  • Escalate operational issues or irregularities to the Client Group Manager in a timely manner.
Reporting & Documentation
  • Maintain accurate records of client group accreditation statistics, issues, and resolutions.
  • Support regular reporting on volumes, progress, and operational status.
  • Assist with post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer activities.
Education & Experience
  • University degree or equivalent experience in Event Management, Operations, Sports Administration, or a related field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in accreditation, event operations, data coordination, or client‑facing roles.
  • Experience working in major events or large‑scale operational environments is an advantage.
  • Exposure to accreditation systems or access control processes is a plus.
Skills & Competencies
  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
  • Strong data handling and administrative accuracy.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast‑paced, time‑critical, and multicultural environments.
  • Ability to follow defined processes and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and online collaboration tools.
Requirements
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Recruitment & Reporting Analyst - People with Disabilities (PWD)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil.
