drills to test operational response and inter-agency coordination • Design and implement programmes to ensure compliance with statutory qualification and licensing standards on site, including the development of quality control audit processes • Engage with safety and security suppliers to ensure that capability-building programmes are delivered effectively and that all personnel are trained before commencing work • Coordinate with other FWWC2027 functional areas to ensure alignment on policies, procedures and response protocols • Oversee the delivery and evaluation of drills, simulations and readiness exercises to ensure operational effectiveness • Identify training gaps and implement corrective actions through continuous improvement processes • Conduct on-site quality control audits to verify training completion, certification and operational competence • Support senior management and site management in verifying training-related supplier invoices and compliance documentation
Education • University degree in security management, education and training, public safety, risk management or a related field • Professional training qualification or certification (e.g. instructional design, adult learning, security training accreditation) is desirable
Experience • Experience in safety and security training, workforce readiness or operational preparedness roles • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering structured training programmes in large-scale operational environments • Experience coordinating exercises, simulations and multi-agency readiness activities • Familiarity with Brazilian licensing and qualification requirements in the security sector • Experience working with public security authorities and private security suppliers
Skills & Competencies • Strong instructional design and training delivery capability • Structured and analytical approach to readiness measurement and workforce tracking • Excellent organisational and project management skills • Ability to coordinate complex multi-stakeholder exercises and rehearsals • Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement capability • Clear written and verbal communication skills • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
Certifications & Requirements: • Right to work in Brazil. • Fluent in English (spoken and written) • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: F&B Concessions Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
FIFA has setup a fully owned Local Entity to deliver the ninth edition of the FIFA Women’s World Cup™, held in Brazil. The success and the growth of the competition depend on the ability and capabilities of the FIFA team to provide an enhanced experienced to all the key stakeholders linked to the tournament: fans and spectators following the event, participating teams and FIFA Commercial Partners.   

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Manager is responsible for managing the operational planning and delivery readiness of the Public Food & Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme across all official tournament stadiums. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights.

The role is responsible for overseeing concessionaire operational planning, coordinating tournament deliverables, ensuring compliance with FIFA requirements, and supporting venue readiness activities. The F&B Concessions Manager acts as the primary operational interface between FIFA, appointed concessionaires, stadium authorities, and Host Football Associations (FAs) to ensure all operational requirements are planned, documented, and delivered according to FIFA timelines and standards.

The role does not hold responsibility for commercial negotiations, contractual management, menu approval, pricing strategy, Commercial Partner relationship management, or defining commercial rights delivery strategy, which remain under the responsibility of the Senior F&B Concessions Manager and FIFA Partnership Rights Delivery team.

Key responsibilities
  • Manage appointed F&B Concessionaire(s) throughout the planning and delivery phases, monitoring compliance with FIFA requirements, project timelines and agreed operational deliverables;
  • Manage the planning and implementation of the Public Food & Beverage Concessions Programme across all official tournament stadiums, ensuring operational readiness, consistency of delivery and compliance with FIFA requirements;
  • Manage the operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme, ensuring approved products, services and activation requirements are successfully integrated into stadium operations;
  • Establish, implement and maintain operational procedures, controls, checklists and reporting mechanisms to support the successful delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme;
  • Review, track and manage concessionaire deliverables, operational plans and readiness submissions, ensuring all requirements are delivered in accordance with FIFA standards and tournament deadlines;
  • Coordinate the development and implementation of operational plans covering staffing, logistics, inventory management, food safety, sustainability, service delivery and contingency planning across all official stadiums;
  • Develop and deliver training programmes, operational briefings and implementation guidelines for concessionaires, service providers and venue-based F&B resources;
  • Oversee the review, mapping and optimization of F&B infrastructure, facilities and operational layouts within stadiums to support efficient service delivery and compliance with tournament requirements;
  • Support the F&B Concessions team in the preparation and coordination of planning activities with FIFA Partnership Rights Delivery (Zurich) and other relevant FIFA functional areas to ensure alignment of operational and commercial objectives;
  • Supervise the development and delivery of stadium F&B operations by appointed concessionaire(s), ensuring approved Commercial Partner requirements are implemented and stakeholder expectations are achieved;
  • Manage operational relationships with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), FIFA functional areas and venue stakeholders, ensuring effective communication, coordination and information flow throughout all tournament phases;
  • Coordinate the reviewing and implementation of F&B operational signage elements, including menu boards and other concession-related branding and information materials, in collaboration with FIFA Partnership Rights Delivery and appointed concessionaires;
  • Monitor stadium infrastructure and operational readiness delivery against established requirements, producing regular status reports, risk assessments and mitigation plans;
  • Manage and coordinate the team of F&B Venue Managers, providing leadership, guidance and operational support across all official tournament venues;
  • Support FIFA and FIFA27 Headquarters throughout tournament operations by consolidating venue reporting, monitoring operational performance, coordinating issue resolution and ensuring consistent implementation of FIFA standards across all stadiums;
  • Oversee daily public F&B concession operations during the tournament, supporting the resolution of operational challenges and ensuring service levels and spectator experience objectives are achieved;
  • Coordinate testing events, operational rehearsals and readiness exercises to validate concessionaire preparedness and support successful tournament delivery;
  • Produce operational reports, readiness updates, post-event evaluations and lessons learned documentation to support decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives;
  • Establish reporting procedures and communication protocols between venue-based F&B teams and FIFA27 Headquarters to ensure consistent implementation of operational standards across all venues.
  • Minimum 4 years’ experience in the food and beverage, catering, or related professional area;
  • Proven successful management and delivery of F&B concessions projects at major international and high-profile events, preferably in the sports industry;
  • Advanced knowledge of the food & beverage concessions industry and preferably at football stadiums; 
  • Experience in major international sports / large-scale event management; 
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, including overlay, preferably in the sports industry;
  • Experience in project infrastructure management;
  • Knowledge of basic utilities requirements, especially for food & beverage concessions (electricity, water supply, etc);
  • Knowledge of food safety and hygienic requirements for food & beverage concessions operation;
  • Knowledge and demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently;
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal;
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines;
  • Innovator and added-value approaches towards commercial rights delivery;
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) planning software and online collaboration tools;
  • Proven successful management and delivery of F&B concessions projects at major international and high-profile events, preferably in the sports industry;
  • Advanced knowledge of the food & beverage concessions industry and preferably at football stadiums;
  • Experience in major international sports / large-scale event management;
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, including overlay, preferably in the sports industry;
  • Experience in project infrastructure management;
  • Knowledge of basic utilities requirements, especially for food & beverage concessions (electricity, water supply, etc);
  • Knowledge of food safety and hygienic requirements for food & beverage concessions operation;
  • Knowledge and demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently;
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal;
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines;
  • Innovator and added-value approaches towards commercial rights delivery;
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) planning software and online collaboration tools;
  • Right to work in Brazil;
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written);
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written);
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel Agents
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Acting as secretary to the Agents Chamber by handling legal disputes between member associations, clubs, players, coaches and agents within the FIFA Agents Chamber
  • Giving written and/or oral advice on the FIFA Football Agent Regulations to players, clubs, member associations, agents, legal advisors, etc.
  • Conducting regulatory investigations and drafting decisions to enforce compliance with the FIFA Football Agent Regulations
  • Supporting the Litigation Department when needed within the scope of appeals lodged against FIFA’s decisions before CAS
  • Managing licensing applications through the FIFA Agent Platform (e.g. processing applications, responding to external inquiries, carrying out communications)
  • Investigating compliance with the FIFA Football Agent Regulations and reporting findings to the relevant departments
  • Providing comments and feedback to legal documents and general matters related to FIFA Football Agent Regulations, including draft Regulations, commentaries, explanatory notes, memos and similar
  • Researching and analyzing the decisions on agent contractual disputes/license applications of FIFA General Secretariat, the FIFA Football tribunal and CAS, setting up a database of relevant jurisprudence
  • Drafting circulars and legal correspondence for FIFA member associations and external parties
  • Mentoring other team members, advising on substantive legal matters, as well as efficient ways to allocate time and resources
  • Proactively managing a varied workload, maintaining steady progress across all matters and reporting to the Head of Department
  • Providing support to the Head of Department, supporting the definition and execution of the strategy of the Department.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work from the outset
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with strong judgment and a focus on practical outcomes
  • Proactive approach to work, anticipating challenges and opportunities, and proposing practical solutions
  • Strong sense of ownership, taking responsibility for assigned matters and driving them to completion
  • Positive attitude towards work, with a collaborative mindset and a strong commitment to teamwork
  • Demonstrates autonomy, sound judgment, and the ability to identify and prioritize matters effectively
  • Respectful of organizational structures, internal processes and policies, and decision-making frameworks
  • Strong case management skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple complex matters, prioritize effectively, monitor deadlines, and drive cases through to timely resolution
  • Strong sense of responsibility and accountability
  • Self-confidence and diplomacy
  • Solution-oriented and innovation skills, with a great ability to embrace change and new technologies and processes
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
  • Excellent drafting skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly, logically, and in a well-structured manner
  • Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to respond quickly to changing circumstances, priorities, and business needs
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Fully qualified to practice law (admitted to the Florida bar or eligible to register as Florida Authorized House Counsel) having completed academic and practical training
  • A master's degree (LL.M. or equivalent postgraduate qualification) is highly desirable
  • Experience working in an international and multicultural environment
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in contractual disputes, including the assessment of claims, review and analysis of evidence, development of legal arguments, and drafting of legal briefs, submissions, or decisions
  • Advanced knowledge of football governance, the international transfer market, FIFA regulations, and sports dispute resolution mechanisms, including their practical implementation through digital systems and regulatory processes
  • Technical expertise in the FIFA Transfer Matching System, as well as in Jira, SharePoint and Confluence
  • Software development project management skills an asset
  • At least 7 years of relevant professional experience, including significant exposure to contractual and regulatory matters, dispute resolution, stakeholder management, and the independent handling of complex legal issues
  • Fluency in English
  • Proficiency in French/Spanish/German (FIFA languages) an asset
  • Proficiency in Word/PowerPoint/Excel
  • Familiarity with Jira an asset
  • Readiness to do standby duties
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager and working closely with the Ticketing Group Sales Manager, the Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will support the implementation of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers, to specifically fulfil all Group Sales ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these customers. The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations, whilst providing support to Group Sales customers with ticketing issues and enquiries. 

The Ticketing Group Sales Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement customer care processes across all established communications channels (email, phone, and any other ticketing bespoke systems), in line with the applicable strategy. 
  •  Support regular quality assurance checks across the customer care operation, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations. 
  •  Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required. 
  •  Support and maintain relationships with Group Sales customers, resolving issues and enquiries. 
  •  Monitor ticket inventory, order status and deadlines for Group Sales bookings. 
  •  Issue all necessary ticketing communications and be able to translate into required languages, where applicable. 
  •  Present ticketing information to Group Sales customers and other stakeholders, both in person and online, as required. 
  •  Follow established communication and escalation processes and support their consistent implementation across stakeholders. 
  •  Implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible. 
  •  Support the research and implementation of solutions to increase the productivity of the group sales customer care team and maximize customer information and satisfaction. 
  •  Analyse and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care being delivered. 
  •  Proactively identify and report on patterns and risks and implement processes to mitigate them. 
  •  Ensure that all customer care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc. 
  •  Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the relevant customer care information is available and share applicable knowledge. 
  •  Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and knowledge base, in all languages. 
  •  Report on the implementation of sales strategy and ticketing requirements. 
  •  Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and project plans and compliance with ticketing policies, regulations and GDPR. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Experience in the planning and delivery of a similar project for a major international sports event. 
  • Experience in customer care delivery for Group Sales, corporate customers and/or business stakeholders. 
  • Experience working within small, cross-functional teams, with exposure to day-to-day task coordination. 
  • Delivery of user acceptance tests. 
  • Ticketing. 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for major sports events. 
  • Customer Service. 
  • Excellent communication and relationship management. 
  • Good numeracy. 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation. 
  • Accountability and Transparency. 
  • Analysis and Innovation. 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability. 
  • Perseverance and Dedication. 
  • Proactivity and Organisation. 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation.
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Fluent in Spanish, French or German, spoken and written.   
 
TECHNOLOGY 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.   
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Assist with the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Support the coordination of workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work with the Workforce Management team to help align workforce plans with operational requirements
• Provide administrative support in maintaining workforce categories and entitlements data
• Maintain and regularly update the centralised headcount tracker, ensuring accuracy of data
• Support change management activities by tracking updates and communicating changes to relevant stakeholders
• Assist in collecting and preparing inputs for workforce budgets, timelines, and planning activities

Workforce Operations & Management
• Support the delivery of operational workforce plans during tournament time, including assisting with site operations
• Help gather and document requirements for workforce spaces, equipment, and operational needs on site
• Support the documentation and maintenance of workforce policies, procedures, and operational guidelines
• Assist in mapping and documenting workforce planning and operational processes
• Provide administrative and coordination support for workforce systems and tools
• Support the delivery of workforce training sessions, including preparation of materials and logistics
• Assist with scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including staff and volunteers
• Provide on-the-ground operational support to venue managers during event delivery
• Help communicate workforce processes and procedures to ensure consistency
• Track workforce service levels and support reporting on entitlements and delivery

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
• Liaise with cross-functional teams (e.g., Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to support workforce needs
• Maintain regular communication with functional areas to gather and update operational requirements
• Provide coordination support between workforce teams, HR, and other stakeholders

  • Work Experience
    • Ideally experience with exposure to workforce planning, operations, events, or a related field
    • Basic to intermediate understanding of workforce planning systems, tools, and processes
    • Experience supporting or assisting with operational teams, preferably in event or venue environments
    • General understanding of data and its use in workforce planning and decision-making
    • Ability to organise tasks, manage priorities, and work with guidance in a structured environment
    • Experience collaborating with team members and contributing to a positive team environment
    • Good communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability and willingness to support problem-solving and coordination activities
    • Experience working in or interacting with multicultural and/or multinational environments is an advantage
    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
    • Portuguese language skills (basic to advanced) are an advantage

  • Technology
    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

Workforce Operations & Management • Support the delivery of operational workforce plans during tournament time, including assisting with site operations • Help gather and document requirements for workforce spaces, equipment, and operational needs on site • Support the documentation and maintenance of workforce policies, procedures, and operational guidelines • Assist in mapping and documenting workforce planning and operational processes • Provide administrative and coordination support for workforce systems and tools • Support the delivery of workforce training sessions, including preparation of materials and logistics • Assist with scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including staff and volunteers • Provide on-the-ground operational support to venue managers during event delivery • Help communicate workforce processes and procedures to ensure consistency • Track workforce service levels and support reporting on entitlements and delivery
Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement • Liaise with cross-functional teams (e.g., Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to support workforce needs • Maintain regular communication with functional areas to gather and update operational requirements • Provide coordination support between workforce teams, HR, and other stakeholders
- Work Experience • Ideally experience with exposure to workforce planning, operations, events, or a related field • Basic to intermediate understanding of workforce planning systems, tools, and processes • Experience supporting or assisting with operational teams, preferably in event or venue environments • General understanding of data and its use in workforce planning and decision-making • Ability to organise tasks, manage priorities, and work with guidance in a structured environment • Experience collaborating with team members and contributing to a positive team environment • Good communication skills, both written and verbal • Demonstrated adaptability and willingness to support problem-solving and coordination activities • Experience working in or interacting with multicultural and/or multinational environments is an advantage • Fluent in English, both written and spoken • Portuguese language skills (basic to advanced) are an advantage - Technology • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Licensing & Retail (Snr) Manager – retail & planning (Freelancer, Fixed-Term)
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team as a freelancer and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Day-to- day product x marketing management of assigned FIFA retail and eCommerce accounts.
  • Contribution to the overall FIFA retail strategy providing ongoing strategic input and recommendations to drive sales and revenue, and the consumer journey.
  • Account management of the assigned retail accounts including merchandising, product, logistics, operational matters, royalty reporting etc.
  • Plan and manage the product assortment and buy for FIFA retail channels together with retail operators to ensure best in class assortment and in working closely with licensing team.
  • Identify the product opportunities and drive the product development with licensing managers to ensure event & 365 retail and eCommerce needs are met.
  • Work with FIFA cross-functional teams to coordinate product collection releases, promotions, storytelling, marketing campaigns and consumer engagement initiatives.
  • Manage , own and plan the product roll-out calendar and marketing calendar for FIFA retail channels.
  • Manage specific licensing & retail projects, including DTR projects as directed.
  • Support the licensing & retail team in managing FIFA licensees in relation to FIFA retail opportunities and needs.
  • Works closely and proactively with the L&R controller to ensure all projects are measured and tracked to drive data-based decisions and recommendations and financial remunerations are accurately recorded, processed and invoiced.
  • Oversee market benchmarking and monitor unauthorised FIFA IP product & retail activities.
  • Support the team lead in any RFP process relating to retail. 
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar or related role
  • Experience in assortment planning or buying across DTC/retail & ecommerce
  • Experience in sports, sports related or sport licensing environments
  • Project management experience is an asset
  • Demonstrable experience in retail marketing is an asset 
  • Understanding or retail operations, logistics, innovation and technical developments is an asset
  • Extremely proficient in Word / PowerPoint
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience in working with planning tools  (including project management) and systems is a plus
  • Understanding of ecom systems (e.g shopify, etc) is a plus
  • Fluent in English: Proficiency in any other language is an asset 
  • Solid knowledge of the retail and ecommerce landscape and the sports licensed business and its key players
  • Experienced working with and through systems that direct and inform work streams and stakeholder management
  • Excellent networker and communicative with a deep understanding or the need to inform and consult with colleagues and other relevant stakeholders
  • Willingness to travel when required

job.title: Access Management Briefing & Reporting Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, the Access Management Briefing & Reporting Manager will be a key member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Access Management team. 

The Access Management Briefing & Reporting Manager will support the planning and delivery of access management operations across the tournament stadiums, providing data analysis, reporting, training material development as well as logistics, administrative and onboarding support.

They will be responsible for providing a range of tools and reports to assist in the planning of the FWWC2027 at all stadiums.  Such tools and reports will include:

·        Utilizing existing and previous event data to identify arrival patterns of spectators and accredited personnel at the stadiums, based on client groups and stadium capacities. 

·        Creating usable reports for HQ, management and identified stake holders pertaining to the movement of spectators and staff during the tournament period. 

·        Creating and updating Tournament Time Dashboards for venues, HQ.

·        Supporting the Access Management team with Operational Readiness.

Through close coordination with the Access Management Team and other Functional Areas (FA), they ensure that the operations relating to the movements of persons holding an access device into and within the stadiums meet the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well-planned ingress, circulation & egress. 

The Access Management Manager Briefing & Reporting will manage a Coordinator Briefing & Reporting whose primary function will be to support the Manager, and conduct data deep dives, and research as necessary.   

The Access Management Manager Briefing & Reporting will be an active member of the Access Management (ACS) HQ team throughout the planning phases and the tournament period. During event time, they will support the ACS team at the HQ and if necessary, at one of the FWWC2027 venues.


The main responsibilities and oversights of the Access Management Manager Briefing & Reporting for the FIFA Woman's World Cup 2027 include:  
·        Develop training materials for ACS staff, safety & security staff and volunteers. 
·        Create, format, and maintain professional presentations, reports, and other business documentation.
·        Support the preparation of team workshops including managing calendars, team travel logistics and scheduling activities as required.
·        Maintain organized records, documentation, and shared team resources.
·        Assist with general administrative tasks and process coordination to support business operations.
·        Coordinate onboarding activities for new employees to ensure a smooth transition into the organization. 
·         Liaise with internal departments such as HR, IT, Facilities, Security, and other relevant stakeholders to facilitate new joiner setup. 
·        Creating data and intelligence formulated reports as required to assist in the safe planning of the tournament.
·        Support the preparation of team workshops including managing calendars, team travel logistics and scheduling activities as required.
·        Utilizing existing and previous event data to identify arrival patterns of spectators and accredited staff personnel at the stadiums, based on client groups and stadium capacities. 
·        Creating usable reports for HQ, management and identified stake holders pertaining to the movement of spectators and staff during the tournament period. 
·        Creating Tournament Dashboards for the FWWC27 venues and HQ.
·        Support with tournament Operational Readiness.
Education:

·        Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. 

·        If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.

·        Football crowd dynamics knowledge. 

·        FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. 

·        Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.

·        Strong problem solving and analytical skills.

·        Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.

·        Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

Experience:

·        Minimum experience of 4 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, , safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage.

·        Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. 

·        Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure

Skills & Competencies:
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyze one’s behavior, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.

DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances. 

INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 

INITIATIVE: Capacity to do things on one’s own initiative and to influence the course of events, assume responsibilities, and achieve objectives with a minimum of supervision and control.

INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas. 

LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.

VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.
 
Certifications & Requirements

·        Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
·        Strong knowledge of Excel and Data analysis & Interpretation.
·        Right to work in Brazil.

Languages

·        Fluent in Portuguese and English. Other languages are an advantage.

job.title: Venue Safety & Security Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Venue Safety & Security Manager (VSSM) is responsible for the operational planning and delivery of safety and security across all official non-competition sites within their designated host city or host city cluster for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. This includes team base camps, training sites, official hotels, transport hubs and other designated locations, including off-city sites requiring travel. Reporting to the Manager, Non-Competition Sites, the VSSM provides senior-level operational leadership and acts as the primary safety and security liaison at host city level. The role ensures compliance with FIFA regulations, local statutory requirements and tournament operational plans, while maintaining structured coordination with public security authorities, site authorities and private security suppliers. The VSSM must demonstrate senior standing and credibility, particularly in engagements with law enforcement and public security agencies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Plan and deliver safety and security operations across all designated non-competition sites within the assigned host city (venue) or cluster.
  • Ensure implementation of the Safety & Security Strategy, Operational Plan, site operating plans and all relevant tournament planning documents as relevant to each venue and site
  • Conduct just-in-time planning activities including deployment planning, supplier site induction, readiness planning, training and briefings
  • Develop, review and update dot plans, deployment plans, rosters and standing instructions for private security suppliers
  • Review and update site-specific risk assessments and ensure mitigation measures are implemented
  • Manage operational delivery through appointed private security supplier(s) and other allocated workforce groups
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with local government authorities, police, law enforcement agencies and other public security partners
  • Act as the principal liaison for public security authorities in the host city for non-competition sites
  • Coordinate secure team and referee movements between official sites and stadiums in collaboration with public security partners
  • Liaise and cooperate with site authorities, hotel management, training site operators and transport stakeholders
  • Liaise and cooperate with FIFA Safety & Security Officers (FSSOs), Team Security and Referee Security Liaison Officers (TSLOs/RSLOs) deployed in the host city
  • Attend and contribute to planning meetings, joint exercises and inter-agency coordination sessions
  • Conduct site inspections to ensure compliance with planning, overlay requirements and security standards
  • Escalate safety and security issues to the Manager, Non-Competition Sites and ensure appropriate follow-up and corrective action
  • Ensure all safety and security staff under supervision are fully briefed on site-specific procedures and tournament regulations
  • Provide daily reporting to tournament HQ during operational periods
  • Attend debriefs and submit written reports and operational assessments as directed
  • Manage time flexibly and ensure attendance at official site activities involving teams, including travel to off-city base camps as required
  • Attend planning meetings, training sessions, exercises and debriefs as directed
Education
  • Higher education in security management, public safety, risk management or a related field
  • Relevant professional qualifications or licensing required by local or state legislation
Experience
  • Strong experience managing safety and security operations in major events, public security or comparable environments
  • Strong background in law enforcement, public security authority or senior private security leadership
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with public authorities and multi-agency partners
  • Experience managing operational security delivery across multiple sites
  • Experience managing staffing budgets and supplier performance
  • High level of spoken and written English

Skills & Competencies
  • Senior-level stakeholder engagement and negotiation skills
  • Strong operational leadership and decision-making capability
  • Ability to build credibility with public security authorities
  • Structured planning and risk assessment capability
  • High level of integrity and professional conduct
  • Ability to operate independently across dispersed geographic areas
  • Calm and decisive under pressure
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese
  • Strong IT literacy 

Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Valid driving licence (mandatory)
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearances (if required)
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Technical Director, Rwanda Football Federation
job.html_description:
The Rwanda Football Federation invites applications for the position of Technical Director. The appointee will lead football development across Rwanda and build connected pathways from grassroots participation to high performance for girls, boys, women and men in Rwanda.
  • Develop, cost and implement a multi-year national technical development strategy aligned with FERWAFA priorities, FIFA and CAF programmes, and available resources; maintain clear annual targets and reporting.
  • Lead grassroots and school football, youth development, talent identification, academies and regional pathways, with a deliberate transition into club and national team environments.
  • Expand opportunities, qualified staffing and competition pathways for women and girls; embed inclusion, child safeguarding, welfare and integrity in every programme.
  • Lead coach education, educator development, licensing pathways and continuing professional development; coordinate with refereeing, futsal, beach soccer and other technical units within their mandates now and in the future.
  • Provide technical oversight and coordination for national team pathways, performance analysis, sports science and medical collaboration, respecting head coaches’ match and team selection responsibilities.
  • Manage the technical department, plans, budgets, procurement inputs, partnerships, performance data and donor or FIFA and CAF programme reporting; work with clubs, leagues, schools, districts, ministries and international partners.
Essential:
  • Substantial senior experience leading football development or comparable technical programmes;
  • Demonstrated delivery of strategy across several age groups or levels; experience supervising teams and budgets;
  • Credible knowledge of coach development and talent pathways;
  • Commitment to women’s football, safeguarding and ethical leadership;
  • Excellent written and spoken English and/or French;
  • Ability to work in Rwanda or obtain appropriate authorization.
  • A relevant university degree or recognized advanced football technical or coaching qualification is required.
FERWAFA will assess equivalent combinations of formal study and substantial technical leadership experience where its policy permits.

Desirable:
  • FIFA or CAF technical leadership education;
  • Advanced CAF, UEFA or equivalent coaching licenses or coach educator qualification;
  • Experience in an association or multi-stakeholder national system;
  • Fluency in either English or Kinyarwanda;
  • Demonstrated work in African football.
These are advantages, not automatic exclusion criteria.
Submit:
  1. a cover letter explaining relevant results;
  2. a current CV;
  3. copies of key qualifications;
  4. a two-page vision for football development in Rwanda covering the first three years; and
  5. contact details for two professional referees.
Please indicate any actual or potential conflict of interest. Reference checks will be conducted only at the appropriate stage with candidate consent.

Selection and equal opportunity
Applications will be screened against the stated criteria, followed by a scored shortlist, a technical exercise, presentation and structured interview.

FERWAFA is committed to fair recruitment and welcomes qualified applicants regardless of sex, disability or background.
Candidates may request reasonable assessment accommodations through careers@ferwafa.com. Personal information will be used for recruitment and handled under
applicable privacy rules.

Send the complete application through FIFA Portal and/or careers@ferwafa.com by 20th November 2026 at 17h00’ (Kigali Time). Use the subject “Technical Director application
– Full name”.

FERWAFA will contact candidates selected for the next stage. No fee is charged for this recruitment.

job.title: Academy Driver (Part-Time)
job.plain_text_description:
The Academy Driver is responsible for providing a safe, reliable and professional driving service across. the Academy. Reporting to the Head of Academy Operations, the role includes, management of part-time drivers (exclusively Academy), and to work alongside the Club Driver & Fleet Compliance Manager ensuring all vehicles are maintained and presented to a professional standard. The Academy Driver delivers a consistent, reliable service to ensure safe transport of Academy players, staff and guests.
This will be a part-time (20-hour) role, with hours split across a 7-day week.
Responsibilities
- Provide transport for identified registered players to and from our Motspur Park training site. - Provide transport for trialist players to and from airports, train stations, accommodation, and club activities. - Support the player induction process when identifying players in need of transport support. - Act as a guide for visits to Motspur Park and Craven Cottage. - Assist the club on 1st team match days for corporate driving requirement. - Support the Academy across key events and wider activities. - Promote the work of Fulham Academy amongst the London football community. - Always represent Fulham Football Club to a high standard in line with club values.
Requirements
- Hold a full clean driving licence - Interact with others in a positive manner - Strong understanding of the local area - Positive ability to work within a diverse organisation - Self-starter who takes pride in the delivery of a professional service - Bi-Lingual (Desired) - D1 driving licence (Desired)

job.title: Academy Goalkeeping Coach (Part Time)
job.html_description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated Foundation Phase Goalkeeping Coach to join our Academy coaching team for the 2026/27 season. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering the Academy Goalkeeping Coaching Programme, supporting the development of young goalkeepers within the Foundation Phase and ensuring a smooth transition between the Pre-Academy, Foundation Phase, and Youth Development Phase.

Working within a player-centred environment, you will be responsible for planning, delivering, and reviewing high-quality coaching sessions that support the technical, tactical, physical, and psychological development of our goalkeepers. You will work closely with Academy staff to create a positive learning environment that maximises each player's potential.

This is a fixed-term contract for the 2026/27 season, based on 18 hours per week, with the potential for the role to be extended into the 2027/28 season. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious coach looking to contribute to a progressive Academy programme and support the development of the next generation of goalkeepers.

Responsibilities

The Academy Goalkeeping Coach must:
  • Be player/person centred & individualised in their approach 
  • Have a strong understanding of goalkeeper coaching & player development principles 
  • Have strong communication skills with young players, their parents and colleagues 
  • Have excellent Technical/Tactical Goalkeeping detail 
  • Be pro-active & hard working 
  • Be open and honest with feedback
  • Be highly motivated & passionate about supporting young goalkeepers 
  • Be willing to share work and learning with others 
  • Have a desire to engage in reflective practice 
  • Hold a UEFA B Goalkeeper Coaching Licence 
  • Hold a UEFA B Coaching Licence 
  • Hold an up-to-date Emergency First Aid in Football (EFAiF) Certificate through The FA 
  • Hold an up-to-date FA Safeguarding Children Certificate

Ideally, the Academy Goalkeeping Coach will:
  • Hold a UEFA A Goalkeeper Coaching Licence 
  • Hold the FA Youth Award 
  • Hold the FA Advanced Youth Award

Requirements

The Academy Goalkeeping Coach (‘AGC’) is employed to prepare, deliver and review Goalkeeper coaching activities in line with the Academy’s Performance Plan.

There is a specific requirement for the AGC to support individual Goalkeepers across the Foundation Phase by delivering on the agreed commitments within each players Individual Learning Plan (ILP) and leading the process of continual review and refinement supporting the programme to be suitably responsive to each individual’s dynamic needs. 

This essentially makes the AGC responsible for the following, non-exhaustive list:
Preparing
  • Support the Lead Schoolboy Academy Goalkeeper Coach, and where necessary lead, with the creation and ongoing development of the Individual Learning Plans for all Foundation Phase Goalkeepers. 
  • Plan and prepare engaging goalkeeping sessions that aid individual player development in an integrated fashion with a specific focus on goalkeeping techniques. 
  • Prepare honest, thoughtful and impactful content for Individual Player Reviews and Parent Reviews. 
  • Liaise with age group coaches to ensure clear communication on the Goalkeeping Programme. 
  • Proactively engage within age group multi-disciplinary teams (‘MDT’) to provide the best possible support for each individual Goalkeeper. 
  • Provide advanced and consistent communication on programme logistics via the Clubs communication app (Teamworks) to players & parents.

Coaching
  • Lead the delivery of the Academy Goalkeeper Coaching Programme across the Foundation Phase. 
  • Support Academy Goalkeepers on Match days with purposeful pre-match and in-game Coaching. 
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of the Foundation Phase Goalkeeper Curriculum. 
  • Deliver sessions that stretch and challenge the clubs Foundation Phase Goalkeepers whilst continuing to develop their love and passion for the role of the Goalkeeper.
  • Proactively support Foundation Phase Goalkeepers within team training sessions. 
  • Assist and support Goalkeeper coaching sessions across the pathway, as and when required. 
  • Contribute to Talent Identification processes and evenings across the season, as and when required.

Reviewing
  • Systematically log and record training sessions via the Football Intelligence Platform (Kitman Labs). 
  • Support the Lead Schoolboy Goalkeeper Coach with honest and meaningful feedback, on player performance and progression, within Player Review Meetings and Parent Review Meetings. 
  • Contribute proactively to Goalkeeper Department meetings and Goalkeeper MDT meetings. 
  • Reflect on, and review, individual player performance and potential, to aid the decision-making process within Succession Planning meetings.

Benefits

We expect to close applications on Friday 2nd October, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

job.title: FP Academy Individual Skills Coach (Part Time)
job.html_description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate coach to join our Academy on a 12-hour per week fixed-term contract for the 2026/27 season. The successful candidate will be responsible for planning, delivering and reviewing high quality coaching sessions in line with the Academy Performance Plan, supporting the individual development of Academy players against agreed goals. Working collaboratively within the Academy programme, they will also contribute to the ongoing development of the Academy Performance Plan and support the achievement and evolution of the Academy's technical objectives.

Responsibilities

The Academy Individual Skills Coach must: 

  • Be player/person centred (individualised) in their approach to development. 
  • Have a strong understanding of coaching and player development principles, ensuring alignment in both beliefs and actions, with the Academy Performance Plan.
  • Have experience of working with (ideally coaching, teaching, educating or supporting) young people and parents in an Academy or Educational setting.
  • Hold appropriate and up to date First Aid and Safeguarding qualifications to conform to Professional Game Academy Audit Company (PGAAC) and Premier League Youth Development Rules (PLYDR) requirements.
  • Hold a minimum UEFA B (FA Level 3, inclusive of the FA Youth Award) coaching licence and remain up to date with the continual professional development requirements associated with such licence.
  • Have broad awareness of the football industries governing policies and youth football protocols, in particular all relevant aspects of the Premier Leagues Youth Development Rules.
  • Be diligent, hard-working, detail driven and (largely) intrinsically motivated by the Academy’s mission.
  • Hold a forward thinking, positive and optimistic mindset and nature.
  • Demonstrate and model high levels of professionalism in organisation, delivery and conduct.
  • Be able to continuously demonstrate openness, inclusiveness and a willingness to collaborate within everyday behaviours.
  • Show pro-activeness and be able to work around or overcome obstacles that others may find challenging.
  • Have knowledge of regulations and expected practices in relation to working with young people, with particular reference to safeguarding, well-being and safety.
  • Have high-level interpersonal skills, including being an effective and adaptable communicator.
  • Demonstrate resilience towards the everyday rigours of high-performance environments.
  • Be willing to hold honest and supportive conversations with parents, guardians or carers of Academy players.
  • Be highly motivated and passionate about supporting players (and staff) to achieve development outcomes.
  • Understand the importance of being a ‘confident custodian’ for an organisation with history and tradition.
 
Ideally, the Academy Coach (part time) will: 
 
  • Hold the FA Talent Identification Level 1 qualification.
  • Hold a higher education degree in coaching, analysis or sports science (or similar qualification).

Requirements

The Academy Individual Skills Coach (AISC) is employed to prepare, deliver and review coaching activities, with specific age groups, in line with the Academy’s Performance Plan. 
 
There is a specific requirement for the AISC to support individual players across the Foundation Phase age groups by delivering on the agreed commitments within each players individual learning plan (‘ILP’) and leading the process of continual review and refinement to support the programme to be suitably responsive to each individual’s dynamic needs.
 
This essentially makes each AISC responsible for the following, non-exhaustive, list:
 
Preparing
  • Supporting Head Coaches with the creation and ongoing development of ILPs for all Foundation Phase players.
  • Support Assistant Coaches with the creation of monthly individual planning processes, ensuring all players across the Foundation Phase receive at least one 15-minute individual technical session each month.
  • Support, and where needed lead, the communication with players and parents around individual timetables and development progress.
  • Be aware of, and where needed contribute to, the creation of team training plans.
  • Contribute towards the preparation of meaningful content for individual player reviews.
  • Support, and where needed lead, the preparation of content for team and individual performance education delivery.
 
Delivering
  • Lead the delivery of individual training sessions (both inside and outside of team training sessions) in line with ILP commitments, in collaboration with the age group head and assistant coaches. 
  • Support, and where necessary lead, the delivery of team training sessions in line with the expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Coaching Handbook) specifically integrating team and individual outcomes into representative practice.
  • Support, and where necessary lead, teams and individuals through fixtures, both home and away, as part of the Foundation Phase games programme.
  • Support, and where necessary lead, teams and individuals through tours and tournaments aligning the environment design and coaching behaviours to the expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan.
  • Support, and where necessary lead, the delivery of performance education sessions in line with the expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Coaching and Insights Handbooks).
 
Reviewing
  • Lead the effective review of individual training sessions and their impact on player development and player-coach-Academy relationships over time.
  • Support the effective review of team training sessions in line with reflection guidance outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Coaching Handbook).
  • Contribute to the effective review of individual (and where needed, team) match performances.
  • Contribute to the ongoing ‘rolling’ review of each players ILP, ensuring the creation of clear action plans, involving colleagues from different disciplinary backgrounds, through weekly MDT meetings.
  • Record reflections on personal coaching performance (in both training and game environments) in line with the ‘reflection’ guidance outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Coaching Handbook).
  • Contribute to the effective review of the Foundation Phase Technical Programme, including activities such as; player reviews, parent reviews, performance education, the games programme, etc.
 

Benefits

We expect to close applications on 16 October, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

job.title: 1st Team Head of Performance (Women)
job.html_description:
The Head of Performance (Women) will provide strategic leadership across the medical, rehabilitation and physical
development functions within Fulham FC Women, ensuring players are physically prepared, robust, ready and able to consistently perform at their highest level.

Working closely with the Head Coach, coaching, medical, analysis and operations teams and leading the performance team, the role will develop and implement an integrated performance strategy that connects physical preparation, injury prevention, rehabilitation, return to football, load management and long-term player development.

The role will lead the performance provision for the 1st Team, while ensuring clear communication and alignment
between the medical and physical development departments.

A key responsibility will be to establish a high-performance culture and environment in which player availability, physical development and performance are prioritised, while maintaining a player-centred approach to individual needs and development.

Working commitment: 3.5 days (28 hours)

Responsibilities

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:

Strategic:
• Lead the design, implementation and review of the club's annual performance strategy, ensuring alignment with football objectives and player development priorities.
• Provide strategic oversight of the performance services provision for the First Team, including medical, physical
development and nutrition.
• Develop an integrated approach between physical development, medical, rehabilitation and football performance that promotes best practice in women's football.
• Work closely with the Physical Development Coach to ensure physical preparation reflects the demands of the team's playing style and competition level.
• Create and maintain a clear process for medical and performance information to be shared with the Head Coach to support training and selection decisions.
• Oversee the monitoring and reporting of performance, wellness, training load and injury data to support evidence-based decision making.

Leadership:
• Line manage performance department staff and support their ongoing professional development.
• Conduct regular performance reviews, objective setting and professional development planning for departmental staff.
• Work closely with the Lead Physio and wider medical team to ensure high standards of player care and wellbeing.
• Promote effective communication between Medical, Physical Development, Coaching and Analysis.
• Ensure appropriate communication between medical staff, coaching staff and players regarding player availability and restrictions.
• Be an active member of the Women's Management Team (WMT), contributing to the development of departmental strategy, standards and culture.
• Contribute to staff meetings, planning meetings and multidisciplinary player reviews, where directed by the Head Coach.

Operational/ Compliance:
• Establish effective processes for injury prevention, assessment, treatment, rehabilitation and return to play.
• Support the development and implementation of return-to-training and return-to-play protocols.
• Ensure appropriate medical records, screening data and performance information are maintained in line with club policies and professional standards.
• Oversee the effective delivery of physical preparation programmes during pre-season, in-season and transition periods.
• Ensure all performance practices comply with relevant club policies, professional standards, Football Association
regulations, Women's National League requirements and any future competition regulations.

Requirements

The Head of Performance (Women) must:
• Hold an undergraduate degree in Sports Science, Strength & Conditioning, or a closely related field.
• Have a Professional Accreditation from a recognised body (e.g., UKSCA, NSCA-CSCS, or BASES).
• Have the FA Introduction to First Aid in Football certificate (valid and in date).
• Have the FA Safeguarding Certificate (valid and in date).
• Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with players,
colleagues and key stakeholders.
• Have experience managing teams of people towards desired strategic outcomes.
• Have experience working within elite female sports programmes and/or elite football environments.
• Show an ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team, whilst also working independently when
required.
• Demonstrate excellent organisational skills, with strong attention to detail and consistently high professional
standards.
• Have the ability to appropriately challenge, support, and motivate colleagues and players.


Ideally, the Head of Performance (Women) will:
• Masters degree Sports Science, Strength & Conditioning, or a closely related field.
• Have their UEFA B Licence (or currently working towards).
• Demonstrate experience working with elite female footballers.
• Have experience using HUDL/ WIMU, Kitman Labs, Teamworks.
• Have the ability to make effective decisions under pressure.
• Demonstrate resilience, accountability and ownership in challenging situations.

job.title: Host Family
job.html_description:
Are you passionate about football and looking for a unique opportunity to make a difference in the lives of young athletes, aged 15-21?


Fulham FC is seeking warm and welcoming host families to provide a safe and supportive home environment to support our Academy players who will be required to live away from home to fulfil their education and football training at our club.


As a host parent, you will play an essential role in helping our players thrive both on and off the pitch. You'll provide a comfortable living space, home-cooked meals, emotional support and help them to adjust to life away from home as they focus on their training and academic pursuits.


What we are looking for:
  • A friendly, caring family or individual with a spare room
  • A willingness to provide support, guidance, and encouragement to our young players
  • A safe and welcoming home environment
  • Support our young people by teaching them basic independent living and self-care skills such as washing, cooking and cleaning up after themselves.
  • Providing meals in line with nutritional guidance from the Academy.
  • Accommodation has access to public and local amenities with good transport links to the Academy training ground.
  • Report any welfare concerns to the Academy Safeguarding and Player Care team should they occur.
  • Include our young people in family life as much as they feel comfortable with.
  • The club will regularly inspect and visit the placement during the season.
  • The club will provide further guidance to host families, young people and their parents explaining what would be expected of them.

In order to be considered for this position you must live within 30 minutes travel for the player from the training ground.

Fulham Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and young people and expects host families to share this commitment. As such, the host family provider will be subject to an Enhanced Disclosure & Barring Service (DBS) check and risk assessments prior to a placement commencing.


Any other person over the age of 18, who resides in the household or has regular contact with the player will be required to complete an enhanced DBS. Host Families will be required to attend safeguarding training and workshops arranged by the Academy.


We are committed to supporting an environment where all staff have a personal responsibility to uphold the Club’s Equal Opportunities Policy by treating fellow employees, prospective employees, casual workers, prospective casual workers, players, prospective players and customers fairly and impartially.

job.title: First Team Performance Analyst - Set Pieces
job.html_description:
Fulham Football Club is seeking an experienced performance analyst to join the First Team Analysis Department and lead its set-piece analysis, working closely with the First Team Set-Piece Coach.

The successful candidate will design, deliver, and evaluate elite-level tactical intelligence focusing specifically on attacking and defensive set-pieces, alongside comprehensive opposition analysis. Working closely with the Coaching Staff, Set-Piece Coach, and Head of Performance Analysis, you will transform raw video and data metrics into actionable, high-impact tactical strategies to maximize the team's competitive advantage.

Responsibilities

Qualifications & Experience
  • Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years working within an elite professional football environment (preferably holding a First Team role).  
  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Sports Science, Performance Analysis, or a related discipline is highly desirable.
  • Coaching Badges: UEFA B coaching badge or above is highly desirable. 
  • Drone Flying License:  Drones are used extensively to capture training practices, and it would be highly desirable for the candidate to hold an official Drone Flying License.

Technical Skills
  • Analysis Software: Advanced proficiency in Hudl Sportscode, or similar industry-standard tagging software.
  • Visual Tools: Proven experience creating high-end telestrations using Coach Paint, or Hudl Studio.
  • Data Integration: Strong literacy in data platforms (e.g., Opta, Wyscout, StatsBomb) with the ability to blend data with video context. Knowledge of Python, R, or Tableau is a plus.

Personal Attributes
  • Communication: Ability to convey complex tactical concepts into simple, visual messages for players and management.  Strong presentation and document building skills helping compile and communicate key findings.  
  • Flexibility: Absolute willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and extensive travel for away fixtures.
  • Technically skilled:  Ability to set up essential equipment for live matchday delivery. Helping the analysis team deliver data, insights and footage to coaches in the fast-paced live matchday environment.  
  • Working under pressure:  Due to the nature of the sport candidates must be able to deliver and work under pressure, dealing quickly and confidently with technical issues which may arise to help ensure the analysis requirements are met.  
  • Forward thinking / Pioneering approach:  A forward-thinking attitude, bring to the table modern ideas and approaches in the use of data and video.  Be aware of industry trends and apply modern technologies to working practices to help the department and club improve.   
  • Discretion: Highest level of professionalism and confidentiality regarding club tactics, data, and internal operations.

We expect to close applications on Friday 4th December, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

Requirements

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Trend Identification: Conduct exhaustive video and data scouting of opposition set-piece habits, including routines, player positioning, blocking strategies, and goalkeeper vulnerabilities. 
  • Design & Collaboration: Work alongside the coaching staff to develop innovative attacking set-piece routines and robust defensive structures tailored to each opponent.
  • Database Management: Build and maintain an internal library of league-wide set-piece trends, tracking metrics such as xG from set plays, first-contact percentages, and delivery types.
  • Performance Evaluation: Deliver comprehensive post-match reviews evaluating the effectiveness of the team's set-pieces and overall tactical execution.
  • Individual Feedback & Reporting: Provide video feedback and data documentation packages to coaches to support continuous development and insights.
