- Experience of coaching adolescents in a Category 1 and/or Premier League Academy setting. - Experience of supporting parents/carers of adolescents within similar settings. - Experience of delivering individual player development programmes (ILPs/IDPs) within a multi-disciplinary environment. - Hold appropriate and up to date qualifications to conform to Professional Game Academy Audit Company (PGAAC) and Premier League Youth Development Rules (PLYDR) requirements. - UEFA A Licence (FA Level 4 qualification), and remain up to date with associated CPD requirements. - FA Advanced Youth Award (FA Level 4 qualification). - Valid FA Introduction to First Aid in Football certificate. - Valid FA Safeguarding Children certificate. - Broad awareness of the football industry’s governing policies and youth football protocols, in particular the Premier League’s Youth Development Rules. - Knowledge of regulations, research and expected practices in relation to working with adolescents, with particular reference to safeguarding, well-being, social development and safety. - Be player/person-centred (individualised) in approach to development. - Have high-level interpersonal skills, including being an effective and adaptable communicator. - Demonstrate resilience towards the everyday rigours of high-performance environments. - Be diligent, hard-working, detail-driven and intrinsically motivated by the Academy’s mission. - Hold a forward-thinking, positive and optimistic mindset. - Be willing to hold honest and supportive conversations with parents, guardians or carers of Academy players.
Ideally, the Under 18 Head Coach will hold or have:
- A minimum of 2 years’ coaching experience within the Professional Development Phase (U16–U21) at a Category 1 Academy. - Experience of leading or supporting the development of less experienced coaching staff. - Experience within the England Youth International pathway or equivalent representative football. - The FA Talent Identification Level 1 qualification. - A related higher education degree in coaching, analysis or sports science (or similar qualification). - Confidence, in the use of video/performance analysis platforms (e.g. HUDL or similar) to support individual player development. - Awareness of First Team environments and the holistic demands placed on elite level athletes. - Continuously demonstrates openness & inclusiveness. - Action orientated; solution focused. - Show pro-activeness and an ability to work around or overcome obstacles that others may find challenging. - Understand the importance of being a confident custodian for an organisation with history and tradition.
Requirements
The Under 18 Head Coach (‘U18 HC') is employed to prepare, deliver and review coaching activities in line with the Academy’s Performance Plan.
There is a specific requirement for the U18 HC to support individuals as they move into and through the Professional Development Phase by delivering on the agreed commitments within each players Individual Learning Plan (ILP) and leading the process of continual review and refinement supporting the programme to be suitably responsive to each individual’s dynamic needs.
This essentially makes the U18 HC responsible for the following, non-exhaustive list:
Preparing
- Lead the creation and ongoing development of both Individual Learning Plans and the Age Group Plan for the U18s. - Play an active role in the transition of players from the U16 age group into the PDP, working closely with U16 coaching staff to ensure continuity of style, expectations and individual development priorities. - Lead and sustain frequent, consistent and supportive communication with all players and their families to support transitions into Professional Football. - Lead the Multi-Disciplinary Team to create seasonal, weekly and daily, team and individual training plans. - Lead the preparations of meaningful content for individual player (and parent) reviews. - Support the preparation of content for team and individual Performance Education, Physical Development and Psychology delivery, ensuring integration where possible. - Align video to team and individual commitments, supporting team and individual player development over time.
Delivering
- Lead the delivery of team training sessions in line with the expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Technical Plan) specifically integrating team and individual outcomes into practice. - Lead the delivery of individual training sessions (both inside and outside of team training sessions) in line with ILP commitments. - Lead teams and individuals through fixtures, both home and away, as part of the age group games programme, ensuring we are appropriately competitive. - Lead teams and individuals through tours, tournaments and competitions aligning the environment design and coaching behaviours to the expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan. - Lead the delivery of performance education sessions in line with the expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Technical Plan). - Support the delivery of the U16 and U21 programmes, as needed. - Attend first team games and youth international football events as required. - Oversee the implementation of the Academy Values and Behaviours towards staff and players.
Reviewing
- Lead the effective review of team training sessions in line with ‘reflection’ expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Technical Plan). - Lead the effective review of individual training sessions and their impact on player-coach relationships and player performance over time. - Review all team and individual match performances in all games programme, tours and tournament fixtures. - Coordinate the ongoing ‘rolling’ review of each player’s ILP, ensuring the creation of clear action plans, involving colleagues from different disciplinary backgrounds, through weekly MDT meetings. - Lead all player and parent review meetings, ensuring player and parent feedback is recorded and agreed actions are shared and followed up. - Ensure each player’s Performance Clock is up to date and accurate. - Ensure all players are provided with regular access to their personal performance data, highlighting key metrics in line with the Academy Technical Plan. - Support the feedback process for all trialists.
Leadership & Collaboration
- Be an active role model for all Academy coaches across the pathway and wider Club environment. - Offer guidance and support to less experienced coaching colleagues, taking a specific and regular interest in the upper part of the YDP. - Act as a key point of connection between the U16 age group and the PDP, and support alignment between the U18 and U21 programmes. - Consistently demonstrate, and hold others to, the highest levels of professionalism. - Support the delivery of coach development events across the year, as required. - Be part of the Academy Technical Group, shaping the Technical Strategy for the long term. - In collaboration with the Head of Talent ID & Recruitment, support the retention and recruitment of Academy players, including feedback for trialists and identification of players ready to progress from the U16 age group. - In collaboration with the Head of Performance, coordinate the effective review of the physical development programme and performance of the age group fitness coach. - In collaboration with the Head of Insights, coordinate the effective review of the performance education programme and performance of the age group analyst.
Benefits
We expect to close applications on Friday 2nd October, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

job.title: Academy Education Post-16 Teacher (Maternity Cover)
job.html_description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and organised Teacher to join our team on a fixed-term basis covering maternity leave. This role is expected to last for approximately 7 months from October 2026.

The Post-16 Teacher will lead on the delivery of the Academy’s scholarship education programme, primarily teaching the BTEC Level 3 in Sporting Performance and Excellence, as well as the Sporting Excellence Professional (SEP) qualification. You will consistently deliver outstanding teaching and learning in your own practice and play a key role in driving high standards of teaching and learning across the department. You will be responsible for ensuring players make good progress towards their target grades in each qualification.
 
The successful candidate will play a key role within the pastoral team, supporting the holistic, off-pitch development of our players. Operating across phases, the role’s primary purpose is to add value to all aspects of our players’ educational programmes and to contribute towards maintaining the Academy’s Category 1 status.

Responsibilities

The Post-16 Teacher plays a central role in delivering and developing the Academy’s education programme, with a particular focus on the BTEC Level 3 in Sporting Performance and Excellence and the Sporting Excellence Professional (SEP) qualification. This role involves delivering consistently high-quality teaching and learning, tracking and supporting academic progress, and contributing to the holistic development of players through mentoring, pastoral support, and leadership of key initiatives. The successful candidate will also support wider departmental responsibilities, including destination tracking, school liaison, and compliance with EPPP and Premier League education standards, ensuring that the Academy continues to provide bespoke education pathways for its players.
 
The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role: 
 
  • To help ensure the Academy Mission is achieved.
  • Deliver the BTEC Level 3 in Sporting Performance and Excellence and the Sporting Excellence Professional (SEP) qualification.
  • Plan and deliver high-quality, engaging lessons that drive outstanding teaching and learning, ensuring all learners make sustained progress.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality departmental resources, including schemes of work and assessment materials.
  • Monitor, track, and support the academic progress of all scholars, using data to inform timely interventions.
  • Create a positive, inclusive learning environment that promotes the highest standards of behaviour for learning amongst learners.
  • Take ownership of professional development and actively engage in relevant training and CPD opportunities.
  • Coordinate and conduct regular academic and pastoral progress reviews with players and their schools across phases.
  • Support the delivery of the Academy Life Plan, ensuring alignment with player development objectives.
  • To support the Youth Development Phase Compensatory Education Programme.
  • Attend relevant department, phase-specific, and league-led education meetings.
  • Support post-scholarship destination tracking and transitions.
  • Act as a liaison for school engagement, particularly with YDP players.
  • Coordinate or support YDP education projects and events.
  • Ensure compliance with EPPP, Premier League, and external quality assurance frameworks, including preparation for audits and visits.

Requirements

The Academy Education Post-16 Teacher must have: 
 
  • Educated to degree level.
  • PGCE with QTS or equivalent.
  • Experience of delivering a BTEC at KS5.
  • Experience of delivering KS3 and KS4 curriculum.
  • A commitment to plan and deliver high-quality, engaging lessons that drive outstanding teaching and learning, ensuring all learners make sustained progress.
  • Working knowledge of BTEC qualifications.
  • A commitment and experience of supporting young people holistically.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with players, parents, and colleagues.
 
Ideally Academy Education Post-16 Teacher will have: 
 
  • Experience working within an elite sporting or performance environment.
  • Knowledge of Academy football and the Elite Player Performance Plan (EPPP).
  • Experience of delivering an A-Level.
  • Experience delivering the Sporting Excellence Professional (SEP) apprenticeship.
  • PE based teaching experience. 
  • Experience in coordinating or leading education programmes.
  • Experience of working with external partners, including schools and awarding bodies.

Benefits

The closing date for applications is Friday 13th November.

job.title: Payroll Manager
job.html_description:
At Fulham Football Club, we are looking for an experienced and highly capable Payroll Manager to take ownership of the payroll function across the Fulham Group.
 
This is an exciting opportunity to join the Finance team within a Premier League football club and a wider, growing group of businesses. The Payroll Manager will be responsible for ensuring the accurate, timely and compliant delivery of payroll across a diverse workforce, including professional football players, permanent employees and a significant casual workforce.
 
Although our brand is most closely associated with Premier League football, the Group now comprises three main businesses: 
 
  1. Fulham Football Club, incorporating the First Team and Academy, with a staff of approximately 400 permanent employees and a significant casual workforce; 
  2. The Fulham Football Club Foundation, the Club’s official charity, which engages in a range of community work and has approximately 40 permanent staff and a large casual population; and  
  3. Fulham Pier, a new 365-day venue on the banks of the River Thames, comprising bars, restaurants, conference and events spaces, a hotel and a spa, which has around 30 permanent staff.     
 
The role therefore offers the opportunity to lead payroll across an unusually varied organisation, combining the demands of elite professional sport with hospitality, events, charitable activities and other commercial operations.
 
Reporting to the Head of Finance, the Payroll Manager will have overall responsibility for the end-to-end payroll process across the Group. The successful candidate will work closely with colleagues across Finance, HR and the wider business and will be expected to combine strong technical payroll knowledge with excellent attention to detail, organisation and stakeholder management.

Responsibilities

Essential
  • Significant experience managing or taking senior responsibility for an end-to-end UK payroll function, ideally within a complex organisation.
  • Strong technical knowledge of UK payroll legislation and requirements, including PAYE, National Insurance, statutory payments, pensions and RTI.
  • Experience managing a large and complex payroll, involving different employee populations, contractual arrangements and pay structures.
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, with the confidence to challenge information, identify anomalies and resolve issues.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and consistently deliver against fixed payroll deadlines.
  • Strong systems and Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to work confidently with significant volumes of payroll data.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work effectively with employees and senior stakeholders across the organisation.
  • High levels of discretion, integrity and professionalism when handling confidential and highly sensitive information.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach, with the ability to take ownership of the payroll function and effectively manage and develop others.
 
Preferred
  • Experience working within professional football, professional sport or another complex, fast-paced organisation.
  • Experience managing payroll within a multi-entity or group structure.
  • Experience managing payroll for a significant casual or variable-hours workforce.
  • Experience with Miracle Payroll and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

Requirements

We are looking for an experienced payroll professional who is comfortable taking ownership of a complex payroll environment and ensuring that appropriate controls, processes and checks are maintained throughout.
 
The Payroll Manager will be expected not only to deliver an accurate payroll each month, but to understand the underlying data, challenge information where appropriate, identify potential issues and continually look for opportunities to strengthen and improve the payroll function.
 
The following is a non-exhaustive list of the key responsibilities of the role:
  • Take overall ownership of the end-to-end payroll process across the Fulham Group, ensuring payroll is delivered accurately, efficiently and on time.
  • Review, challenge and approve payroll inputs including salaries, bonuses, overtime, casual hours, deductions, benefits and contractual payments, ensuring appropriate supporting information and approvals are in place.
  • Oversee all payroll changes, including new starters, leavers, salary amendments, contractual changes and promotions, maintaining strong controls around sensitive and high-value payments.
  • Take ownership of payroll compliance, including PAYE, National Insurance, statutory payments, RTI submissions, pension obligations and other relevant HMRC requirements.
  • Manage pension administration and submissions, including reconciliations and compliance with auto-enrolment requirements.
  • Own payroll reconciliations, ensuring payroll outputs reconcile appropriately to the general ledger, bank payments, pension submissions and HMRC liabilities.
  • Work closely with Finance and HR to ensure employee information is accurately reflected within payroll and payroll costs are appropriately recorded and understood within the monthly management accounts.
  • Act as the principal point of contact for payroll matters across the Group, providing a high-quality service to employees and confidently supporting senior stakeholders where required.
  • Provide effective management and development of payroll support within the team, ensuring responsibilities throughout the payroll cycle are effectively delivered.
  • Lead payroll year-end requirements, including P60s, P11Ds and other relevant statutory reporting, and support internal and external audit requirements.
  • Maintain accurate payroll records, documentation and audit trails, ensuring appropriate confidentiality, GDPR compliance and data security at all times.
  • Maintain strong payroll procedures and controls, ensuring the function is resilient, well documented and not reliant on individual knowledge.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve and automate payroll processes, systems, reporting and controls across the Group.
  • Keep up to date with changes in payroll legislation and provide payroll expertise on wider Finance and HR projects where required.

Benefits

We expect to close applications on Friday 30th October, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

job.title: Director, Video Production
job.location: 1350 NW 55 Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking a Director of Video Production, who will lead a team of shooter/editors, manage their workload, interface with multiple departments across the Club, solicit feedback and manage expectations during the creative process. The individual in this role must be an experienced videographer as well as manager of people, who can prioritize multiple projects at once and understands the professional sports landscape and the type of content it requires. We are seeking an excellent visual storyteller who has a fresh and edgy creative style. 


 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a team of videographers of varying levels and skillsets.
  • Lead full-cycle video productions including capture and editing of all Club video needs, such as: Matchday coverage,
  • Digital/Social pieces, In-stadium videoboard pieces, corporate partnership fulfillment, and ticket sales video needs
  • Collaborate with all in-house departments, external agencies, and corporate partners on video projects
  • Take video briefs from start to finish (brainstorming, planning, production, post-production, delivery).
  • Manage & organize video archives for all footage (Media Asset Management)
  • Elevate our visual storytelling in alignment with the Club’s brand guidelines and marketing initiatives
  • Manage lighting and audio setups for interviews and other shoots.
  • Maintain, organize and catalogue club-owned video & lighting equipment
  • Maintain strong relationships with outside vendors and continue to grow production vendor database
  • All other related duties as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree with 7-10 years of relevant experience in a similar position.
  • Experience managing a team of direct reports
  • Experience with a professional sports team is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of cinema cameras and lenses (Sony systems).
  •  Advanced use of Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Audition) required.
  • Experience in producing short-form and long-form videos required.
  • Lighting and set design production knowledge
  • Exceptional creative abilities; looking to push the envelope and develop and implement fresh ideas.
  • Understanding of brand awareness.
  •  Superior organization, project management skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, team environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively communicate, both written and verbally.
  • Self-starter with the ability to multi-task and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  •  Exceptional knowledge and passion for the sport and culture of fu´tbol preferred.
  • Physical ability to lift heavy equipment is required.
  • Flexibility to travel domestically and internationally and work nights and weekends as required.
  • Applicant must provide a link to reel or previous work in order to be considered.

 

Compensation: 

  • Inter Miami CF offers a competitive compensation package, medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, life insurance and 401k retirement plan.

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Account Executive, Sales
job.html_description:
Description

  

The Account Executive is responsible for generating new business by selling Inter Miami ticket inventory. It includes the selling of all specified seating categories through cold-calling, face-to-face appointments, and networking with a focus on business-to-business relationships.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prospect, establish, research, and close sales leads through cold-calling, appointments, and networking.
  • Meet or exceed weekly/monthly sales and prospecting goals.
  • Work closely with Ticket Operations and Member Services departments to achieve sales/prospecting goals.
  • Maintain a high level of customer service.
  • Participate in various sales, team, and community events as assigned.
  • Represent the organization at various networking events.
  • Active role in the Inter Miami game day experience.
  • Maintain accurate records in support of sales efforts as defined by the organization.
  • All other responsibilities as required.

Requirements

  • Minimum 1-2 years of sales experience in professional or collegiate sports (or related industry) is preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills required. Bilingual skills a plus.
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills required.
  • Exhibit good judgment and maintain a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, within a team atmosphere.
  • Strong interest in soccer and sports is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) is preferred.
  • Knowledge of ticketing CRM (Salesforce and Archtics is preferred).
  • Experience in the Florida marketplace preferred but not necessary.

 

Compensation: Inter Miami CF offers a competitive compensation package, medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, life insurance and 401k retirement plan.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Manager, Fan Strategy & Experience
job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Fan Strategy & Experience is responsible for leading engagement with Inter Miami CF’s core supporter community, “La Familia,” serving as a key connection point between the Club and its most passionate fans. This role oversees all aspects of supporter group coordination, including game day operations, ticketing, away match travel, and the overall matchday environment.


The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the Club’s culture, a collaborative and team-oriented mindset, and exceptional organizational skills. This individual demonstrates a high level of ownership, a strong work ethic, and a deep appreciation for the sport and fan experience, with a focus on driving engagement and delivering a best-in-class experience for supporters.

 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the club and its official supporter groups (La Familia), building strong relationships and ensuring alignment with club initiatives 
  • Oversee supporter group operations on game days, including pre-game, in-game, and post-game activities to ensure a safe and engaging environment 
  • Partner with Guest Services and Security to plan and manage the experience for visiting team supporters, including coordination with league representatives to ensure safety and compliance 
  • Coordinate with visiting teams to support traveling fans, including ticketing, designated seating areas, and overall event planning 
  • Support the growth and engagement of supporter groups by helping develop programs, benefits, and experiences that enhance membership value 
  • Manage ticketing needs for supporter groups and other key audiences, including season tickets, group sales, and single-game access, in collaboration with internal ticketing teams 
  • Work cross-functionally with Guest Services to enhance the overall fan experience at the stadium 
  • Partner with Community and Foundation teams to support and execute community-focused initiatives and events 
  • Assist the Ticketing team with fan engagement initiatives such as membership events, sales activations, and conducting stadium tours 
  • Collaborate with Marketing to develop and support fan-focused digital content and storytelling initiatives 
  • Partner with Event Presentation to elevate the in-stadium experience and fan engagement during matches 
  • Develop and lead outreach initiatives, including future street team programs, to expand the club’s presence in the community 
  • Support additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in sports administration, sports marketing, hospitality, or a related field 
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international fútbol is a plus  
  • Bilingual proficiency, including Spanish, is a plus 
  • Very strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for the brand 
  • Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and creatively solve day-to-day challenges 
  • Extremely organized with high attention to detail 
  • Strong work ethic and ability to work collaboratively as part of a team with a results-driven mindset 
  • Strong organizational skills with proven experience managing multiple projects and timelines 
  • Knowledge of marketing, promotions, event planning, and game production 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook 
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

 Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Coordinator, Event Presentation
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking a Coordinator of Event Presentation who will be responsible for providing organizational support to the production control room and Director of Broadcast and Event Presentation. 


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Assist in planning, outsourcing, and execution of Private Stadium Events like client parties or meetings, ceremonial Galas. Review all audio/video requests needed throughout the facility.
  • Oversee Control Room Content for Matchday with ingesting and testing of videoboard graphics. Follow-up with respective departments such as Partnerships, Marketing and others who run in-game content. 
  • Assist in rendering and loading LED Content for all stadium matches and events. 
  • Act as producer of home and away radio broadcast setup and execution, including remote coordination and transmission support 
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Venue and outside Production Companies and Broadcast Services
  • Communicate with Rights Holders to understand their contracted requirements, and work with internal departments to ensure all outside Broadcast Support and Rights Holders are accommodated 
  • Assist with MLS Next PRO match productions, with camera setups, sending A/V feeds, working control room equipment. 
  • Assist in the scheduling and management of the Control Room Matchday Staff. 
  • Act as Control Room Operator on equipment if and when needed. 
  • Clip video of any Presentations, Anthem performances, special requests, etc., from all matches and Stadium Events, and provide to respective personnel if / when available or requested. 
  • All other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree with 1 – 2 years of relevant experience in a similar position. 
  • Experience with a professional sports team (a plus). 
  • Knowledge of Control Room equipment such as on-air graphics systems, replay systems (a plus).
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, team environment. 
  • Lighting, set design, and A/V knowledge (a plus).
  • Understanding of brand awareness. 
  • Superior organization, project management skills and attention to detail. 
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively communicate, both written and verbally. 
  • Self-starter with the ability to multi-task and meet deadlines with minimal supervision. 
  • Physical ability to lift heavy equipment is required.
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends and holidays as required.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Retail Sales Associate (Nu Stadium)
job.html_description:
Description

As a Retail Sales Associate, you’ll help fans show their pride and take home a piece of Inter Miami CF. Be part of the energy in our shops and pop-ups at Nu Stadium.


What You'll Do: 

  • Deliver a world-class fan experience in our stadium retail store,on game days only.
  • Engage and assist fans with enthusiasm, sharing your knowledge of the club and merchandise.
  • Operate point of sale systems efficiently to ensure smooth and accurate transactions.
  • Provide product information and communicate in-store promotions clearly.
  • Keep the store organized and visually appealing throughout the shift.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support store operations.

Requirements

  • Prior retail experience preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Must be available to work during home matches, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to work approximately 6-to-8-hour shifts on Inter Miami CF match days.
  • Physical ability to lift, move, and organize inventory in both indoor and outdoor settings.
  • Dependable transportation required.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are a plus.
     

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Merchandise Planner (Retail)
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking a Merchandise Planner to support the financial planning, forecasting, and inventory optimization of the club’s retail and e-commerce merchandise business. This role is responsible for driving data-informed planning decisions that maximize sales, margin, and inventory productivity across channels. The ideal candidate is analytically strong, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with experience balancing financial targets, inventory health, and business needs in a fast-paced retail environment.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


Financial Planning & Forecasting

  • Develop and manage seasonal and annual merchandise plans, forecasts, and budgets.
  • Own sales, margin, and inventory forecasts across retail, stadium, and e-commerce channels.
  • Partner with Finance to align merchandise plans with broader financial targets and reporting.
  • Monitor performance against plan and proactively recommend adjustments to optimize results.


Inventory Management & Optimization

  • Manage inventory flow, depth, and timing to support demand while minimizing risk.
  • Analyze sell-through, weeks of supply, and inventory turns to drive replenishment and exit strategies.
  • Identify risks and opportunities related to overages, shortages, and aging inventory.
  • Support allocation and replenishment strategies to ensure the right product is in the right place at the right time.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Produce regular reporting on sales performance, inventory health, and margin trends.
  • Partner with Merchandising and Licensing teams to provide insights that inform assortment and buy decisions.
  • Analyze product-level and category-level performance to support future planning cycles.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Merchandising, Licensing, Retail Operations, and Supply Chain to align planning assumptions and execution.
  • Support go-to-market planning for key launches, events, and peak business moments.
  • Translate data and insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.


Ownership

  • Maintain accurate planning tools, forecasts, and documentation with high attention to detail.
  • Continuously refine planning processes to improve accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Operate with a solutions-oriented mindset, balancing precision with business agility.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in merchandise planning, retail planning, or a related analytical role.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel or planning tools.
  • Experience forecasting sales, managing inventory metrics, and analyzing performance.
  • Ability to communicate insights clearly to both analytical and non-analytical partners.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven retail environment.

job.title: Store Supervisor (Fort Lauderdale International Airport)
job.location: 100 Terminal Drive, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33315, US
job.html_description:
Description

A Store Supervisor for the Inter Miami CF retail location at Fort Lauderdale International Airport leads daily operations in a fast-paced, high-traffic environment driven by passionate fans and international travelers. This role focuses on maximizing sales of official club merchandise, maintaining strict compliance with airport security and safety regulations, and delivering an exceptional customer experience that reflects the energy and identity of the club. 


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Maintain high store standards and adhere to airport security protocols. 
  • Oversee all warehouse shipping and receiving functions, ensuring timely and accurate processing of incoming and outgoing merchandise. 
  • Manage the replenishment process to ensure the retail floor is consistently stocked with merchandise.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe store environment.
  • Work with the General Manager to determine the most efficient layout and storage solutions.
  • Ensure all stock is clearly labeled, stored systematically, and accessible for restocking and inventory management. 
  • Keep accurate records of all shipping, receiving, and inventory processes.
  • Audit markdowns and inventory processes for accuracy and compliance with standards.
  • Partner with the General Manager to train and develop store associates, fostering a positive and productive work environment. 
  • Recognize and encourage team members through regular feedback and collaboration.
  • Act as a brand ambassador for Inter Miami CF, ensuring merchandise operations reflect the club's professionalism and values. 
  • Ensure exceptional customer service to travelers in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Support additional projects and duties as assigned by the General Manager, including assisting with retail initiatives, seasonal promotions, and operational improvements. 
  • Support scheduling and daily workforce planning to ensure proper staffing coverage aligned with business needs. 
  • Provide hands-on leadership, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and holding team members accountable to operational and customer service standards.

Requirements

  • 1-5 years of experience in warehouse, logistics, or inventory management, preferably in a retail or merchandising setting. 
  • Proven leadership and problem-solving skills. 
  • Attention to detail and ability to maintain an efficient and well-organized workspace. 
  • Maintain full-time availability to work rotating shifts and ensure continuous, smooth operation of the Inter Miami CF airport retail store. 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills for dealing with staff, airport authorities, and diverse customers. 
  • Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. and work in demanding environments. 
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required. 
  • Ability to pass comprehensive airport background checks.

- Maintain high store standards and adhere to airport security protocols. - Oversee all warehouse shipping and receiving functions, ensuring timely and accurate processing of incoming and outgoing merchandise. - Manage the replenishment process to ensure the retail floor is consistently stocked with merchandise. - Maintain a clean, organized, and safe store environment. - Work with the General Manager to determine the most efficient layout and storage solutions. - Ensure all stock is clearly labeled, stored systematically, and accessible for restocking and inventory management. - Keep accurate records of all shipping, receiving, and inventory processes. - Audit markdowns and inventory processes for accuracy and compliance with standards. - Partner with the General Manager to train and develop store associates, fostering a positive and productive work environment. - Recognize and encourage team members through regular feedback and collaboration. - Act as a brand ambassador for Inter Miami CF, ensuring merchandise operations reflect the club's professionalism and values. - Ensure exceptional customer service to travelers in a fast-paced environment. - Support additional projects and duties as assigned by the General Manager, including assisting with retail initiatives, seasonal promotions, and operational improvements. - Support scheduling and daily workforce planning to ensure proper staffing coverage aligned with business needs. - Provide hands-on leadership, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and holding team members accountable to operational and customer service standards.
Requirements
- 1-5 years of experience in warehouse, logistics, or inventory management, preferably in a retail or merchandising setting. - Proven leadership and problem-solving skills. - Attention to detail and ability to maintain an efficient and well-organized workspace. - Maintain full-time availability to work rotating shifts and ensure continuous, smooth operation of the Inter Miami CF airport retail store. - Excellent interpersonal skills for dealing with staff, airport authorities, and diverse customers. - Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. and work in demanding environments. - Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required. - Ability to pass comprehensive airport background checks.

job.title: Manager, Sales
job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Sales will report to the Senior Director of Ticket Sales & Service and plays a key leadership role in driving Inter Miami CF's Membership Sales efforts. This position will be responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Membership Sales Executives while maintaining a strong focus on revenue generation, new business development, sales performance, and achieving both individual and departmental goals.


The ideal candidate is an experienced sports sales leader with a proven track record of consistently achieving and exceeding revenue targets. This individual should possess a strong understanding of the professional sports ticketing industry, demonstrate exceptional leadership and coaching abilities, and thrive in a competitive, fast-paced, goal-oriented environment.

The Manager will be highly involved in the day-to-day sales operation, including pipeline management, KPI tracking, sales strategy, prospecting initiatives, account development, training, and performance management. Success in this role will be measured by the ability to develop a high-performing sales culture, maximize revenue opportunities, and consistently deliver against aggressive membership sales goals.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, motivate, and develop Membership Sales Executives to achieve and exceed individual and team revenue goals.
  • Establish clear expectations around daily, weekly, monthly, and annual sales activity and performance.
  • Partner with the Director of Membership Sales to develop and execute strategies designed to maximize new Membership revenue.
  • Monitor and manage individual and team KPIs, including calls, appointments, presentations, proposals, deposits, closes, revenue, and other key sales metrics.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, pipeline reviews, coaching sessions, and team sales meetings.
  • Provide ongoing sales training focused on prospecting, discovery, presentation skills, objection handling, closing techniques, and account management.
  • Hold sales representatives accountable to established activity and revenue goals while identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Actively participate in the sales process by prospecting, making outbound calls, conducting appointments, presenting Membership opportunities, and closing business.
  • Manage and optimize the team's sales pipeline to ensure a consistent flow of qualified prospects and opportunities.
  • Identify new revenue opportunities through outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, events, partnerships, group opportunities, and other business development initiatives.
  • Assist in developing and executing sales campaigns, promotions, incentives, and strategic initiatives designed to drive Membership sales.
  • Utilize CRM and ticketing systems to ensure accurate account information, consistent sales activity, pipeline management, and reporting.
  • Analyze sales performance and provide regular reporting and recommendations to the Director of Membership Sales and senior leadership.
  • Help establish and maintain sales processes, standards, and best practices that can be replicated across the Membership Sales team.
  • Recruit, onboard, train, and develop new Membership Sales Executives as needed.
  • Assist with interviewing and evaluating prospective sales team members.
  • Represent Inter Miami CF at sales events, networking functions, community events, matches, and other club initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Membership Services to ensure a seamless transition from the sales process to the Membership experience.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the professional sports ticketing marketplace and competitive landscape.
  • Assist with match-day and stadium events as needed to support sales and revenue-generating initiatives.
  • All other responsibilities as required.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Sports Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of successful sales experience within professional sports, collegiate athletics, entertainment, hospitality, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting and exceeding individual and team sales and revenue goals.
  • Previous sales leadership, management, or supervisory experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing, coaching, and developing sales professionals in a performance-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated success in developing sales strategies, managing pipelines, and converting prospects into revenue.
  • Experience with season tickets, memberships, premium seating, suites, group sales, or other sports/entertainment revenue streams strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the sports ticketing sales cycle, including prospecting, lead generation, appointment setting, presentations, closing, and account development.
  • Experience with CRM and ticketing platforms; Archtics and Ticketmaster experience preferred.
  • Experience using data, reporting, and KPIs to evaluate and improve sales performance.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Highly competitive, self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented with a demonstrated desire to win.
  • Ability to effectively coach and hold team members accountable while creating a positive and collaborative team environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Ability to identify challenges, develop solutions, and make sound business decisions.
  • Strong work ethic with a “get the job done” mentality.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish preferred.
  • Experience in the Florida marketplace preferred.
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international fútbol is a plus.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, matches, and events.

Core Competencies

  • Sales Leadership: Ability to lead from the front, establish expectations, coach performance, and consistently drive results.
  • Results Orientation: Demonstrated history of achieving and exceeding aggressive sales and revenue targets.
  • Accountability: Ability to establish clear KPIs, monitor performance, and hold team members accountable to results.
  • Coaching & Development: Ability to identify individual strengths and opportunities while developing sales professionals into higher-performing representatives.
  • Business Development: Ability to identify new prospects, build relationships, generate opportunities, and convert business.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a dynamic, rapidly changing, high-pressure sports environment.


Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Manager, Membership Services
job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Membership Services will support and report to the Director of Membership Services with the development, fulfillment, execution and overall service management for Inter Miami CF Membership Service Department. The Manager will also assist in providing leadership to the service team. Main goal is providing trainings, KPI tracking and be the day-to-day point of contact.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support the Director of Membership Services with the development, fulfillment, execution and overall service management for Inter Miami CF season ticket members.
  • Provide leadership, direction, training and support to Membership Services Executives.
  • Collaborate with CRM/BI department to assign all season ticket members to Membership Service Executives.
  • Reach an agreed upon goal for renewal of season ticket members.
  • Work with Director of Guest Experience on match day to help troubleshoot game day challenges.
  • Field and respond to all season ticket member inquiries, requests, concerns, feedback, etc.
  • Ensure customer data and profile requirements are accurately represented in database.
  • Accurately and successfully convey all key messages to all season ticket members.
  • Work with Director of Membership Service to create all applicable Membership benefits, programs, rewards, experiences and events.
  • Identify opportunities to add-value to Membership benefits, programs, rewards, experiences and events.
  • Identify areas to improve on and off game day experience.
  • Reporting of various individual and/or departmental efforts.
  • Plan, facilitate and execute exclusive season ticket member events throughout the calendar year.
  • Act as information liaison for all Inter Miami CF home games and stadium events.
  • Survey and analysis of various reporting (attendance, game day experience, etc.).
  • All other responsibilities as required.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sports Management, Marketing or related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5+ years’ related experience working in professional or collegiate sports preferred.
  • Experience in the Florida marketplace preferred.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish preferred.
  • Experience with Archtics & Ticketmaster ticket systems preferred.
  • Understanding of Sales and Renewal Process and be able to lead trainings around specific areas.
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international soccer a plus.
  • Highly proactive, goal oriented and motivated with a positive attitude.
  • Very strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for providing great customer service.
  • Coordinate changing priorities in a dynamic, high pressure, fast paced environment.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and creatively solve day-to-day challenges.
  • Extremely organized with a high attention to detail.
  • Strong work ethic – must be a team player with a “get the job done” attitude.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Power Point, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Sr Account Executive, Sales
job.html_description:
Description

Position Summary: As a Senior Account Executive, you are responsible for generating new business and driving revenue by selling Inter Miami CF ticket inventory across designated seating categories. This role will focus on developing new business through strategic prospecting, cold calling, face-to-face appointments, networking, referrals, and business-to-business relationship building. The Senior Account Executive will also serve as a leader within the sales team by helping drive team performance, sharing best practices, and supporting the development of fellow Account Executives.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prospect, research, develop, and close new business through cold calling, face-to-face appointments, networking, referrals, and other outbound sales strategies.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through closing, account development, and retention.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual weekly, monthly, and annual revenue and prospecting goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with businesses, organizations, community groups, and other key partners throughout the South Florida market.
  • Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified prospects and effectively manage sales activity within the organization's CRM.
  • Provide a high level of customer service throughout the sales process and develop relationships that lead to repeat business and referrals.
  • Serve as a resource and mentor to Inside Sales and Account Executives by sharing successful sales strategies, prospecting techniques, and best practices.
  • Participate in team meetings, sales training, role-playing sessions, and other initiatives designed to improve individual and team performance.
  • Represent Inter Miami CF at games, networking events, community initiatives, and other organizational events.
  • Play an active role in the Inter Miami CF gameday experience and assist with hosting clients and prospects.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activities, prospect information, and account details as defined by the organization.
  • Demonstrate leadership, professionalism, and a positive attitude while helping contribute to a high-performance sales culture.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements

  • Minimum 4+ years of successful sales experience, preferably within professional or collegiate sports, entertainment, hospitality, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, close new business, and develop long-term client relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. 
  • Bilingual skills are a plus.
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a highly collaborative team environment.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach, mentor, and positively influence fellow team members.
  • Exhibit sound judgment, professionalism, accountability, and a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, and event days, in a fast-paced sports environment.
  • Strong interest in soccer, sports, and the Inter Miami CF brand is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) is preferred.
  • Experience with ticketing CRM systems; Salesforce and Archtics preferred.
  • Experience working in the Florida/South Florida marketplace is preferred but not required.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Partnership Activation, is responsible for managing all partner related activities including activation and execution of all contractually obligated sponsorship elements. This person will build strong relationships with current partners to aid in the renewal and retention of partners and work to continuously increase the level of service and support offered by the team to corporate partners.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Provide the highest level of service to all existing corporate partners.
  • Gather, plan and execute all contractual elements for each partner.
  • Conceptualize, develop, and map out programs that focus on achieving our partners goals.
  • Act as a sponsorship agency-like consultant internally and on behalf of clients.
  • Collect and maintain partner KPIs, ensuring a focus on partner objectives, tracking ROI and ROO, media and promotional valuations, results, measurements, etc.
  • Create an annual partner activation strategy plan for designated partner accounts to align with the commercial partnerships department and Inter Miami CF goals and objectives. This will include the development of big-idea creative activation programs and co-branded marketing opportunities.
  • Lead all upsell and renewal efforts for assigned corporate partners.
  • Develop strong, long-term relationships with clients. Learn and understand the nuances of the business of each of the organization’s partners and help them achieve marketing goals through the use of Inter Miami CF assets.
  • Plan and manage VIP hospitality events, unique experiences, and special events for partners.
  • Participate in cross functional department meetings and provide regular updates to leadership.
  • Route through the appropriate review and approvals processes all collateral material featuring the Club’s logo for correct usage, i.e., sponsor artwork, radio copy, public address script, videos, logos, print, web, and other relevant items.
  • Produce designated accounts partner recaps, assist in compiling all proof of performance and research data and lead assigned partner recap meetings..
  • Work all home games and assist with on-site partner activations.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum 3+ years of extensive and proven integrated marketing experience with demonstrated success in the media, sports partnerships, fulfillment or entertainment fields required.
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international fútbol a plus.
  • Fluency in Spanish a plus. 
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential for interactions with clients, operational leaders and other senior executives.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and creatively solve day-to-day challenges.
  • Extremely organized with a high attention to detail.
  • Strong work ethic – must be a team player with a “get the job done” attitude.
  • Strong organizational skills with proven experience managing multiple projects and timelines.
  • Knowledge of marketing, promotions, event planning and game production preferred.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, including Power Point, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Intern, IT | Sprint Season
job.html_description:
Description

  

About Us: Miami is a global city fueled by culture, connection and ambition. At Inter Miami CF, we reflect the community we call home through our courage, creativity and passion for the game. We challenge convention, celebrate what makes Miami extraordinary and bring world-class fútbol to a world-class city. We are here to change the game.


Number 10 Internship | Be a Playmaker

The Number 10 Internship is our commitment to developing the next generation of leaders in sports and entertainment. Inspired by fútbol’s No. 10, the visionary, creator and playmaker, our interns gain hands-on experience through meaningful projects, cross-functional collaboration and full immersion in the Club’s day-to-day. It’s an opportunity to learn, contribute and make an impact while building your career in the game.


Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, IT to support technological troubleshooting and customer service within a dynamic environment. 


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist in responding to internal & external technical support requests via phone, email, and ticketing systems.
  • Troubleshoot hardware and software issues for end-users.
  • Document support requests and solutions in the ticketing system to ensure proper follow-up and resolution tracking.
  • Support the installation and set-up of new computer equipment and software.
  • Assist in maintaining inventory of IT equipment and supplies. 
  • Collaborate with team members on IT projects and initiatives to improve user experience and operational efficiency. 
  • Participate in training sessions to enhance technical knowledge and skills.
  • Assist with the setup and preparation of events and game days, and provide on-site IT support during these activities

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Basic understanding of computer hardware, software and networking concepts
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills 
  • Strong reliability and organizational skills
  • Ability to professionally and confidently interact professionally with members at all levels of the organization
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus 

  

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Additional Information:

Start date: January 11, 2027

End date: June 4, 2027

Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

job.html_description:
Description

  

About Us: Miami is a global city fueled by culture, connection and ambition. At Inter Miami CF, we reflect the community we call home through our courage, creativity and passion for the game. It’s an opportunity to learn, contribute and make an impact while building your career in the game.


Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Foundation to to support the Foundation team with fundraising initiatives, game day operations, administrative projects, and community impact programs. This role will assist with the planning, coordination and execution of Foundation campaigns and events while providing exposure to nonprofit operations within professional sports.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist with Foundation fundraising initiatives, including the 50/50 Raffle, Round-Up Campaign, Scoreboard Shoutouts, and Florida Specialty License Plate Program.
  • Support Foundation matchday activations by assisting with event setup, breakdown, logistics, and fan engagement.
  • Assist with recruiting, scheduling, communicating with and managing Foundation volunteers for events and matchdays.
  • Provide administrative support, including data entry, organizing documents, preparing reports, and maintaining records.
  • Assist with project management and task tracking using Monday.com.
  • Coordinate prize fulfillment, donor acknowledgments, and supporter communications.
  • Maintain Foundation inventory and event materials.
  • Assist with Foundation events and fundraising activations throughout the season.
  • Support day-to-day Foundation operations and special projects as assigned.
  • Collaborate with internal departments and external partners to ensure successful execution of Foundation programs.
  • Work from both IMCF Stadium in Fort Lauderdale and NU Stadium, as needed.
  • Work evenings, weekends, holidays, and other non-traditional hours, as needed. 

Requirements

  •  Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Sports Management, Nonprofit Management, Business, Marketing, Event Management, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with Monday.com is a plus
  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Passion for nonprofit work, fundraising, and community impact
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Additional Information:

· Start date: January 11, 2027

· End date: June 4, 2027

· Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Video Production to support the creation of video content across the Club. This role will assist with shooting, editing and producing content for matchdays, events and other Club initiatives.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Shoot matchday footage for social media and news outlets.
  • Capture daily events in an ENG format, as well as creative content.
  • Edit footage into deliverable content within established deadlines. 
  • Edit video projects from initial footage through final delivery.
  • Assist with post-production by identifying and organizing footage that aligns with the team’s creative vision.
  • Assist with setting up camera, lighting, and audio equipment for shoots. 
  • Contribute creative ideas for new content and opportunities.
  • Organizing assets and log footage. 
  • Assisting with matchday operations for the Video Production Team.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Film, Video Production, Digital Media, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Experience with basic video editing
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop) is a plus
  • Basic lighting and audio knowledge
  • Creative thinker with the ability to collaborate within a team, develop solutions and identify new opportunities in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours and in various settings within a team environment
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Additional Information:

Start date: January 11, 2027

End date: June 4, 2027

Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week

Primary work location: Fort Lauderdale Training Facility, with the ability to work from Nu Stadium as needed


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Software Engineer to support the development of internal applications, tools, and technology solutions. This role will contribute to both front-end and back-end development, helping build scalable solutions that improve internal processes, data accessibility, and business operations across the organization.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of internal web applications and tools.
  • Contribute to both front-end and back-end development. 
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using PHP, Java, JavaScript, or similar programming languages.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between internal applications, databases, APIs, and third-party systems.
  • Work with SQL and relational databases to retrieve, manage, and structure data used by internal applications.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and improve existing applications and technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with the BI team and other departments to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Support the documentation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance of internally developed applications.
  • Research and apply software development best practices and emerging technologies.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Knowledge of front-end and back-end development and general software development principles
  • Experience or coursework using programming languages such as PHP, Java, JavaScript, Python, or similar
  • Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, APIs, and web application development
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web development concepts
  • Familiarity with Git/version control and software development workflows is a plus
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Additional Information:

Start date: January 11, 2027

End date: June 4, 2027

Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Business Intelligence to assist the BI team with routine and ad hoc customer insights research and reporting. This position is designed to develop foundational skills in business intelligence and customer behavior analytics.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market research to help ideate and develop innovative activation concepts and marketing campaigns for prospective and existing partners.
  • Generate targeted lead lists to support sales efforts for both ticketing campaigns and corporate sponsorship procurement.
  • Update and maintain accurate tracking of sponsorship asset inventory.
  • Compile weekly newsletters summarizing trends, financial news, and significant developments within the sports industry.
  • Monitor and track the performance of the team’s social media channels, creating reports to summarize engagement and ways to improve performance.
  • Execute industry research to inform team of trends emerging across brands, teams, and leagues to assist in the development of new business for the club.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Working knowledge of algorithms for classification, regression, clustering, and anomaly detection 
  • Excellent communication and organization skills, capable of conveying complex data in a clear and concise manner
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.
